            // Load current settings
            try {
                const settings = await window.api.getSettings();

                // Convert sprint_end_date to datetime-local format
                const sprintEnd = new Date(settings.sprint_end_date);
                const dateStr = sprintEnd.toISOString().slice(0, 16);
                document.getElementById('sprintEndDate').value = dateStr;

                document.getElementById('targetBillsMode').value = settings.target_bills_mode || 'auto_unpaid';
                document.getElementById('targetBillsManual').value = settings.target_bills_manual || 0;
                document.getElementById('initialBalance').value = settings.initial_balance || 0;
                document.getElementById('initialBalanceCurrency').value = settings.initial_balance_currency || 'USD';
                document.getElementById('defaultHourlyRate').value = settings.default_hourly_rate || 55;
                document.getElementById('taxReserveRate').value = settings.tax_reserve_rate || 30;
                document.getElementById('exchangeRate').value = settings.exchange_rate_cad_to_usd || 0.7143;

                toggleManualTarget();
                document.getElementById('sprintSettingsModal').classList.add('show');
            } catch (error) {
                alert('❌ Error loading settings: ' + error.message);
            }
        }

        function closeSprintSettingsModal() {
            document.getElementById('sprintSettingsModal').classList.remove('show');
        }

        function toggleManualTarget() {
            const mode = document.getElementById('targetBillsMode').value;
            const manualRow = document.getElementById('manualTargetRow');
            manualRow.style.display = mode === 'manual' ? 'block' : 'none';
        }

        async function saveSprintSettings(event) {
            event.preventDefault();

            const settings = {
                sprint_end_date: new Date(document.getElementById('sprintEndDate').value).toISOString(),
                target_bills_mode: document.getElementById('targetBillsMode').value,
                target_bills_manual: parseFloat(document.getElementById('targetBillsManual').value) || 0,
                initial_balance: parseFloat(document.getElementById('initialBalance').value) || 0,
                initial_balance_currency: document.getElementById('initialBalanceCurrency').value,
                default_hourly_rate: parseFloat(document.getElementById('defaultHourlyRate').value),
                tax_reserve_rate: parseFloat(document.getElementById('taxReserveRate').value),
                exchange_rate_cad_to_usd: parseFloat(document.getElementById('exchangeRate').value)
            };

            try {
                await window.api.updateSettings(settings);
                await loadDashboardData();
                updateStats(); // Force immediate stats refresh
                closeSprintSettingsModal();
                alert('✅ Sprint settings saved successfully!');
            } catch (error) {
                alert('❌ Error saving settings: ' + error.message);
            }
        }

        // Add Manual Session
        async function addManualSession(event) {
            event.preventDefault();

            const dateInput = document.getElementById('manualDate').value;
            const startTime = document.getElementById('manualStartTime').value;
            const endTime = document.getElementById('manualEndTime').value;
            const rate = parseFloat(document.getElementById('manualRate').value);
            const note = document.getElementById('manualNote').value;

            if (!dateInput || !startTime || !endTime) {
                alert('Please fill in Date, Start Time, and End Time');
                return;
            }

            const entryDate = new Date(dateInput);
            const [startHour, startMinute] = startTime.split(':').map(Number);
            const [endHour, endMinute] = endTime.split(':').map(Number);

            let startTotalMinutes = startHour * 60 + startMinute;
            let endTotalMinutes = endHour * 60 + endMinute;
            if (endTotalMinutes <= startTotalMinutes) endTotalMinutes += 24 * 60;

            const hours = (endTotalMinutes - startTotalMinutes) / 60;

            const startTimeFormatted = new Date(entryDate);
            startTimeFormatted.setHours(startHour, startMinute);
            const endTimeFormatted = new Date(entryDate);
            endTimeFormatted.setHours(endHour, endMinute);

            const timeDisplay = `${startTimeFormatted.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true })} - ${endTimeFormatted.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true })}`;

            const isLeisure = rate === 0;
            const earnings = isLeisure ? 0 : hours * rate;
            const opportunityCost = isLeisure ? hours * 24 : 0;

            const sessionData = {
                time_display: timeDisplay,
                timestamp: entryDate.toISOString(),
                date: entryDate.toISOString().split('T')[0],
                hours: parseFloat(hours.toFixed(2)),
                rate: rate,
                earnings: parseFloat(earnings.toFixed(2)),
                note: note,
                is_leisure: isLeisure,
                opportunity_cost: parseFloat(opportunityCost.toFixed(2)),
                is_manual: true
            };

            try {
                await window.api.createSession(sessionData);
                await loadDashboardData();
                closeAddSessionModal();

                // Reset form
                document.getElementById('manualStartTime').value = '';
                document.getElementById('manualEndTime').value = '';
                document.getElementById('manualNote').value = '';
            } catch (error) {
                alert('Error adding session: ' + error.message);
            }
        }

        // Add Bill
        async function addBill(event) {
            event.preventDefault();

            const name = document.getElementById('billName').value;
            const amountCAD = parseFloat(document.getElementById('billAmountCAD').value);
            const amountUSD = parseFloat(document.getElementById('billAmountUSD').value);
            const dueDate = document.getElementById('billDueDate').value;

            const billData = {
                name: name,
                amount_cad: amountCAD,
                amount_usd: amountUSD,
                due_date: dueDate || null
            };

            try {
                await window.api.createBill(billData);
                await loadDashboardData();
                closeAddBillModal();

                // Reset form
                document.getElementById('billName').value = '';
                document.getElementById('billAmountCAD').value = '';
                document.getElementById('billAmountUSD').value = '';
                document.getElementById('billDueDate').value = '';
            } catch (error) {
                alert('Error adding bill: ' + error.message);
            }
        }

        function autoCalculateUSD() {
            const cadInput = document.getElementById('billAmountCAD');
            const usdInput = document.getElementById('billAmountUSD');

            if (cadInput && usdInput && cadInput.value) {
                const cad = parseFloat(cadInput.value);
                const usd = (cad / 1.4).toFixed(2);
                usdInput.value = usd;
            }
        }

        // Edit Session
        async function editSession(id) {
            const session = sessions.find(s => s.id === id);
            if (!session) return;

            showEditSessionModal(session);
        }

        // Delete Session
        async function deleteSession(id) {
            if (!confirm('Delete this session?')) return;

            try {
                await window.api.deleteSession(id);
                await loadDashboardData();
            } catch (error) {
                alert('Error deleting session: ' + error.message);
            }
        }

        // Edit Bill
        function showEditBillModal(bill) {
            document.getElementById('editBillId').value = bill.id;
            document.getElementById('editBillName').value = bill.name;
            document.getElementById('editBillAmountCAD').value = bill.amount_cad;
            document.getElementById('editBillAmountUSD').value = bill.amount_usd;
            document.getElementById('editBillDueDate').value = bill.due_date || '';
            document.getElementById('editBillPaid').checked = bill.paid || false;

            document.getElementById('editBillModal').classList.add('show');
        }

        function closeEditBillModal() {
            document.getElementById('editBillModal').classList.remove('show');
        }

        function autoCalculateEditBillUSD() {
            const cadInput = document.getElementById('editBillAmountCAD');
            const usdInput = document.getElementById('editBillAmountUSD');
            const exchangeRate = userSettings ? userSettings.exchange_rate_cad_to_usd : 0.7143;

            if (cadInput && usdInput && cadInput.value) {
                const cad = parseFloat(cadInput.value);
                const usd = (cad * exchangeRate).toFixed(2);
                usdInput.value = usd;
            }
        }

        async function updateBill(event) {
            event.preventDefault();

            const billId = document.getElementById('editBillId').value;
            const updates = {
                name: document.getElementById('editBillName').value,
                amount_cad: parseFloat(document.getElementById('editBillAmountCAD').value),
                amount_usd: parseFloat(document.getElementById('editBillAmountUSD').value),
                due_date: document.getElementById('editBillDueDate').value || null
            };

            try {
                await window.api.updateBill(billId, updates);

                // Also update paid status if changed
                const paid = document.getElementById('editBillPaid').checked;
                const originalBill = bills.find(b => b.id == billId);
                if (originalBill && originalBill.paid !== paid) {
                    await window.api.markBillPaid(billId, paid);
                }

                await loadDashboardData();
                closeEditBillModal();
                alert('✅ Bill updated successfully!');
            } catch (error) {
                alert('❌ Error updating bill: ' + error.message);
            }
        }

        function editBill(id) {
            const bill = bills.find(b => b.id === id);
            if (!bill) return;

            showEditBillModal(bill);
        }

        // Toggle Bill Paid
        async function toggleBillPaid(id, paid) {
            try {
                await window.api.markBillPaid(id, paid);
                await loadBills();
            } catch (error) {
                alert('Error updating bill: ' + error.message);
            }
        }

        // Delete Bill
        async function deleteBill(id) {
            if (!confirm('Delete this bill?')) return;

            try {
                await window.api.deleteBill(id);
                await loadDashboardData();
            } catch (error) {
                alert('Error deleting bill: ' + error.message);
            }
        }

        // Export Data
        async function exportData() {
            try {
                const data = await window.api.exportData();
                const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = url;
                a.download = `survival-dashboard-export-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.json`;
                document.body.appendChild(a);
                a.click();
                document.body.removeChild(a);
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                closeBurgerMenu();
            } catch (error) {
                alert('Error exporting data: ' + error.message);
            }
        }

        // Import Data
        function importData() {
            document.getElementById('importFile').click();
            closeBurgerMenu();
        }

        async function handleImport(event) {
            const file = event.target.files[0];
            if (!file) return;

            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = async function (e) {
                try {
                    const data = JSON.parse(e.target.result);

                    // Validate data format
                    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') {
                        alert('❌ Invalid data format');
                        return;
                    }

                    // Check if user wants to add to existing data
                    const hasExistingData = sessions.length > 0 || bills.length > 0;
                    if (hasExistingData) {
                        const confirmOverwrite = confirm(
                            `You have ${sessions.length} sessions and ${bills.length} bills in your account.\n\n` +
                            'Import will ADD the data from the file to your existing data.\n\n' +
                            'Continue with import?'
                        );
                        if (!confirmOverwrite) return;
                    }

                    let importedSessions = 0;
                    let importedBills = 0;
                    let skippedSessions = 0;
                    let skippedBills = 0;

                    // Import Sessions
                    if (data.sessions && Array.isArray(data.sessions)) {
                        for (const session of data.sessions) {
                            try {
                                // Map old format to new API format
                                const sessionData = {
                                    time_display: session.time || session.time_display || 'Imported',
                                    timestamp: session.timestamp || new Date(session.date || Date.now()).toISOString(),
                                    date: session.date ? new Date(session.date).toISOString().split('T')[0] : new Date(session.timestamp).toISOString().split('T')[0],
                                    hours: parseFloat(session.hours || 0),
                                    rate: parseFloat(session.rate || 0),
                                    earnings: parseFloat(session.earnings || 0),
                                    note: session.note || '',
                                    is_leisure: session.isLeisure || session.is_leisure || false,
                                    opportunity_cost: parseFloat(session.opportunityCost || session.opportunity_cost || 0),
                                    is_manual: true
                                };

                                await window.api.createSession(sessionData);
                                importedSessions++;
                            } catch (error) {
                                console.error('Error importing session:', error);
                                skippedSessions++;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Import Bills (if present in file)
                    if (data.bills && Array.isArray(data.bills)) {
                        for (const bill of data.bills) {
                            try {
                                // Map bill data
                                const billData = {
                                    name: bill.name || 'Imported Bill',
                                    amount_cad: parseFloat(bill.amount || bill.amount_cad || 0),
                                    amount_usd: parseFloat(bill.amountUSD || bill.amount_usd || (bill.amount / 1.4) || 0),
                                    due_date: bill.dueDate || bill.due_date || null
                                };

                                await window.api.createBill(billData);
                                importedBills++;
                            } catch (error) {
                                console.error('Error importing bill:', error);
                                skippedBills++;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Show results
                    let message = '✅ Import Complete!\n\n';
                    if (importedSessions > 0) message += `📝 Imported ${importedSessions} session(s)\n`;
                    if (importedBills > 0) message += `💸 Imported ${importedBills} bill(s)\n`;
                    if (skippedSessions > 0) message += `⚠️ Skipped ${skippedSessions} session(s) due to errors\n`;
                    if (skippedBills > 0) message += `⚠️ Skipped ${skippedBills} bill(s) due to errors\n`;

                    if (importedSessions === 0 && importedBills === 0) {
                        message = '⚠️ No data was imported. The file may not contain sessions or bills.';
                    }

                    alert(message);

                    // Reload dashboard to show imported data
                    await loadDashboardData();
                    closeBurgerMenu();

                } catch (err) {
                    console.error('Import error:', err);
                    alert('❌ Error importing data: ' + err.message);
                }
            };
            reader.readAsText(file);
            event.target.value = '';
        }

        // Export Bills CSV
        async function exportBillsCSV() {
            closeBurgerMenu();
            try {
                const blob = await window.api.exportBillsCSV();
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = url;
                a.download = `bills-export-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`;
                document.body.appendChild(a);
                a.click();
                document.body.removeChild(a);
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                alert('✅ Bills exported as CSV successfully!');
            } catch (error) {
                alert('❌ Error exporting bills CSV: ' + error.message);
            }
        }

        // Import Bills CSV
        function importBillsCSV() {
            document.getElementById('importBillsCsvFile').click();
            closeBurgerMenu();
        }

        async function handleBillsCsvImport(event) {
            const file = event.target.files[0];
            if (!file) return;

            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = async function (e) {
                try {
                    const csvData = e.target.result;

                    // Check if user wants to add to existing data
                    const hasExistingBills = bills.length > 0;
                    if (hasExistingBills) {
                        const confirmImport = confirm(
                            `You have ${bills.length} bills in your account.\n\n` +
                            'Import will ADD the bills from the CSV file to your existing bills.\n\n' +
                            'Continue with import?'
                        );
                        if (!confirmImport) return;
                    }

                    const result = await window.api.importBillsCSV(csvData);

                    let message = '✅ CSV Import Complete!\n\n';
                    message += `📝 Imported ${result.imported} bill(s)\n`;
                    if (result.errors > 0) {
                        message += `⚠️ ${result.errors} error(s) encountered\n`;
                        if (result.details && result.details.length > 0) {
                            message += '\nErrors:\n';
                            result.details.forEach(err => {
                                message += `Line ${err.line}: ${err.error}\n`;
                            });
                        }
                    }

                    alert(message);
                    await loadDashboardData();

                } catch (err) {
                    console.error('CSV import error:', err);
                    alert('❌ Error importing CSV: ' + err.message);
                }
            };
            reader.readAsText(file);
            event.target.value = '';
        }

        // Logout
        function handleLogout() {
            if (confirm('Are you sure you want to logout?')) {
                localStorage.removeItem('authToken');
                window.location.href = '/login.html';
            }
        }

        // Close modals on outside click
        document.getElementById('addSessionModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id === 'addSessionModal') closeAddSessionModal();
        });

        document.getElementById('addBillModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id === 'addBillModal') closeAddBillModal();
        });

        document.getElementById('editSessionModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id === 'editSessionModal') closeEditSessionModal();
        });

        document.getElementById('editBillModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id === 'editBillModal') closeEditBillModal();
        });

        document.getElementById('sprintSettingsModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id === 'sprintSettingsModal') closeSprintSettingsModal();
        });

        // ESC key to close
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                closeBurgerMenu();
                closeAddSessionModal();
                closeAddBillModal();
                closeEditSessionModal();
                closeEditBillModal();
                closeSprintSettingsModal();
            }
        });
    </script>
</body>

</html>

# 🎭 Guest/Demo Mode Feature Plan

## Executive Summary
Create a fully functional demo version of the dashboard that:
- Acts as the landing page (no auth required)
- Generates realistic fake data dynamically
- Allows users to interact with features
- Has Login/Register buttons prominently displayed
- Data doesn't persist (session-only)
- Can be used to demo the app to friends without exposing personal data

## User Experience Flow

### Landing on Site (Not Logged In)
```
1. User visits https://survival-dashboard.netlify.app
2. Dashboard loads immediately with DEMO MODE banner
3. Fake data is displayed (randomized on each visit)
4. Top right shows: [Login] [Register] buttons
5. Prominent banner: "You're in Demo Mode - Create an account to save your data"
6. User can fully interact: add/edit/delete sessions & bills
7. Changes stored in sessionStorage (lost on tab close)
8. Click Login → Modal appears over dashboard
9. After login → Seamlessly transition to real user data
```

### Demo Mode Features
- ✅ All features work (add/edit/delete sessions & bills)
- ✅ Stats calculate in real-time
- ✅ Timer works
- ✅ Settings can be changed (session-only)
- ✅ Export works (downloads demo data)
- ✅ Import disabled (or shows "Create account to import")
- ⚠️ Persistent reminder that data won't be saved
- 🎨 Visual distinction (banner, watermark, different color accent?)

---

## Technical Architecture

### Option A: Client-Side Only (Recommended)
**Pros:**
- No backend changes needed
- Instant load (no API calls)
- Works offline
- No server costs for demo users

**Cons:**
- Can't share demo sessions (each user gets random data)
- SessionStorage limits (~5MB)

**Implementation:**
```javascript
// On page load
if (!isLoggedIn()) {
    loadDemoMode();
} else {
    loadUserData();
}

function loadDemoMode() {
    // Generate fake data
    sessions = generateRandomSessions();
    bills = generateRandomBills();
    userSettings = generateDemoSettings();
    
    // Store in sessionStorage
    sessionStorage.setItem('demoMode', 'true');
    sessionStorage.setItem('demoSessions', JSON.stringify(sessions));
    sessionStorage.setItem('demoBills', JSON.stringify(bills));
    
    // Render dashboard
    renderDashboard();
    showDemoModeBanner();
}
```

### Option B: Shared Demo Account
**Pros:**
- Everyone sees same demo data
- Can pre-populate with "perfect" example data
- Easier to demo specific features

**Cons:**
- Requires backend modification
- Demo data can be messed up by trolls
- Need to reset demo account periodically

**NOT RECOMMENDED** - Too complex, can be gamed

## Data Generation Strategy

### Realistic Fake Data Generator

#### Sessions (15-25 random entries)
```javascript
function generateRandomSessions() {
    const sessions = [];
    const today = new Date();
    const names = ['Client Project', 'Freelance Work', 'Side Gig', 'Consulting', 'Development'];
    const rates = [45, 55, 65, 75, 85];
    
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        const daysAgo = Math.floor(Math.random() * 14); // Last 2 weeks
        const date = new Date(today - daysAgo * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
        const hours = (Math.random() * 6 + 1).toFixed(2); // 1-7 hours
        const rate = rates[Math.floor(Math.random() * rates.length)];
        const earnings = (hours * rate).toFixed(2);
        
        sessions.push({
            id: `demo-${i}`,
            time_display: date.toLocaleTimeString(),
            timestamp: date.toISOString(),
            date: date.toISOString().split('T')[0],
            hours: parseFloat(hours),
            rate: parseFloat(rate),
            earnings: parseFloat(earnings),
            note: names[Math.floor(Math.random() * names.length)],
            is_leisure: false,
            opportunity_cost: 0,
            is_manual: true
        });
    }
    
    return sessions.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp) - new Date(a.timestamp));
}
```

#### Bills (7-12 random entries)
```javascript
function generateRandomBills() {
    const billTypes = [
        { name: 'Rent', cadRange: [1200, 2500], usdFactor: 0.72 },
        { name: 'Groceries', cadRange: [150, 400], usdFactor: 0.72 },
        { name: 'Utilities', cadRange: [80, 200], usdFactor: 0.72 },
        { name: 'Internet', cadRange: [60, 120], usdFactor: 0.72 },
        { name: 'Phone Bill', cadRange: [30, 80], usdFactor: 0.72 },
        { name: 'Credit Card', cadRange: [100, 800], usdFactor: 0.72 },
        { name: 'Insurance', cadRange: [150, 400], usdFactor: 0.72 },
        { name: 'Gas', cadRange: [50, 150], usdFactor: 0.72 }
    ];
    
    const bills = [];
    const billCount = Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 7; // 7-12 bills
    
    for (let i = 0; i < billCount; i++) {
        const billType = billTypes[Math.floor(Math.random() * billTypes.length)];
        const amountCAD = (Math.random() * (billType.cadRange[1] - billType.cadRange[0]) + billType.cadRange[0]).toFixed(2);
        const amountUSD = (amountCAD * billType.usdFactor).toFixed(2);
        const daysUntilDue = Math.floor(Math.random() * 30) - 5; // -5 to +25 days
        const dueDate = new Date(Date.now() + daysUntilDue * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
        const paid = daysUntilDue < 0 ? (Math.random() > 0.3) : false; // 70% of past bills are paid
        
        bills.push({
            id: `demo-bill-${i}`,
            name: `${billType.name}${Math.random() > 0.7 ? ' (Upcoming)' : ''}`,
            amount_cad: parseFloat(amountCAD),
            amount_usd: parseFloat(amountUSD),
            due_date: dueDate.toISOString().split('T')[0],
            paid: paid,
            paid_at: paid ? new Date(dueDate.getTime() - Math.random() * 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString() : null
        });
    }
    
    return bills.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.due_date) - new Date(b.due_date));
}
```

    };
}

## Code Snippets

### Main Entry Point Modification
```javascript
// At the very start of <script> in index.html

async function initializeApp() {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('authToken');
    
    if (!token) {
        // No token = demo mode
        loadDemoMode();
        showAuthButtons();
        showDemoModeBanner();
    } else {
        // Has token = try to load user data
        try {
            currentUser = await window.api.getProfile();
            await loadDashboardData();
            initializeTimers();
            showUserMenu(); // Burger menu
        } catch (error) {
            // Token expired/invalid = fallback to demo
            localStorage.removeItem('authToken');
            loadDemoMode();
            showAuthButtons();
            showDemoModeBanner();
        }
    }
}

// Call on page load
if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initializeApp);
} else {
    initializeApp();
}
```

### Demo Mode Storage Wrapper
```javascript
// Wrap all API calls to use sessionStorage in demo mode
function isDemoMode() {
    return !localStorage.getItem('authToken');
}

async function getSessions() {
    if (isDemoMode()) {
        const stored = sessionStorage.getItem('demoSessions');
        return stored ? JSON.parse(stored) : generateRandomSessions();
    } else {
        return await window.api.getSessions();
    }
}

async function createSession(sessionData) {
    if (isDemoMode()) {
        const sessions = await getSessions();
        sessionData.id = `demo-${Date.now()}`;
        sessions.unshift(sessionData);
        sessionStorage.setItem('demoSessions', JSON.stringify(sessions));
        return sessionData;
    } else {
        return await window.api.createSession(sessionData);
    }
}

// Repeat for bills, settings, etc.
```

## Benefits

### For You
- ✅ Easy to demo to friends without screen sharing
- ✅ Can share a link instead of walking through features
- ✅ No risk of exposing personal financial data
- ✅ Professional landing page (not just login screen)

### For New Users
- ✅ See the app in action before committing
- ✅ Try features risk-free (no signup required)
- ✅ Understand value proposition immediately
- ✅ Lower barrier to entry

### For Recruitment/Portfolio
- ✅ Hiring managers can try it instantly
- ✅ No need to create accounts for demos
- ✅ Shows UX thoughtfulness
- ✅ Demonstrates full-stack capabilities

---

## Potential Enhancements (Phase 2)

1. **Shareable Demo Seeds**
   - URL param like `?demo=12345` loads specific fake data
   - Can share "This is what working 40 hrs/week looks like" scenarios

2. **Guided Tour**
   - Highlight features one by one
   - "Try adding a session!" tooltips
   - Tutorial mode for first-time users

3. **"Convert to Real Account" Flow**
   - Button to "Keep this data and create account"
   - Demo data gets saved to new user account
   - Seamless upgrade path

4. **Analytics**
   - Track which features demo users try
   - See where they drop off
   - Optimize onboarding flow

---

## Risks & Mitigations

| Risk | Mitigation |
|------|-----------|
| Demo users never convert | Add persistent CTA, limit demo features after X minutes |
| SessionStorage limits | Add quota check, graceful fallback to in-memory |
| Confusion between demo/real | Clear visual distinction, banner, watermarks |
| Poor demo data | Test with real scenarios, iterate on generators |
| Performance issues | Lazy load demo data, optimize generators |

- ✅ Demo mode loads in < 1 second
- ✅ All features work identically to logged-in mode
- ✅ Data persists within browser session
- ✅ Smooth transition from demo → logged in
- ✅ No console errors in demo mode
- ✅ Mobile-friendly

## 📋 Guest/Demo Mode: Full Plan Created

I've written a complete implementation plan in `GUEST_MODE_PLAN.md` covering:

### Key Features
- **Client-side only** (no backend changes, instant load)
- **Dynamic fake data** generation (different each visit)
- **Login/Register buttons** in top right (modal-based, not redirect)
- **Session-only persistence** (data lost on tab close)
- **Full interactivity** (add/edit/delete works, uses sessionStorage)
- **Professional landing page** (not just a login screen)

### Architecture
```
User visits → No auth? → Load demo mode
  ↓
Generate random sessions (15-25 entries, last 2 weeks)
Generate random bills (7-12 entries, realistic amounts)
Generate demo settings (random but sensible)
  ↓
Store in sessionStorage → Render dashboard
  ↓
Show demo banner + auth buttons
User can interact fully → Data persists in session
  ↓
Click Login → Modal appears → After auth → Seamless transition to real data
```

### Estimated Timeline
- **Phase 1:** Core demo mode (2-3 hrs)
- **Phase 2:** Auth integration (1-2 hrs)
- **Phase 3:** Demo interactions (1-2 hrs)
- **Phase 4:** Polish (1 hr)
- **Total:** ~6-9 hours

        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: #1a1a1a;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #444;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: #555;
        }

        /* Badge */
        .badge {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 2px 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: 0.75em;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-left: 8px;
        }

        .badge.manual {
            background: #444;
            color: #999;
        }

        .badge.leisure {
            background: #ff3333;
            color: #fff;
        }
    </style>
</head>

<body>
    <div class="container">
        <!-- Header with Burger Menu -->
        <div class="header">
            <div class="header-title">
                <h1>🔥 SURVIVAL MODE 🔥</h1>
                <div class="header-subtitle">Last Day to Work: October 24, 2025</div>
            </div>
            <button class="burger-btn" onclick="toggleBurgerMenu()">☰</button>
        </div>

        <!-- Burger Menu Overlay -->
        <div class="burger-overlay" id="burgerOverlay" onclick="closeBurgerMenu()"></div>

        <!-- Burger Menu -->
        <div class="burger-menu" id="burgerMenu">
            <div class="burger-menu-header">
                <div class="burger-menu-title">Menu</div>
                <button class="burger-close" onclick="closeBurgerMenu()">✕</button>
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="exportData()">
                📥 Export Data (JSON)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="importData()">
                📤 Import Data (JSON)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="exportBillsCSV()">
                📋 Export Bills (CSV)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="importBillsCSV()">
                📂 Import Bills (CSV)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="showSprintSettingsModal()">
                ⚙️ Sprint Settings
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item logout" onclick="handleLogout()">
                🚪 Logout
            </div>
        </div>
        <input type="file" id="importFile" accept=".json" style="display: none;" onchange="handleImport(event)">
        <input type="file" id="importBillsCsvFile" accept=".csv" style="display: none;"
            onchange="handleBillsCsvImport(event)">

        <!-- Countdown Banner -->
        <div class="deadline-countdown">
            <div class="countdown-timer" id="countdown">--:--:--</div>
            <div class="countdown-label">Until Oct 24 Work Deadline</div>
        </div>

        <!-- Hero Dashboard Grid -->
        <div class="hero-grid">
            <!-- Today's Goal -->
            <div class="card critical">
                <div class="card-title">💰 TODAY'S GOAL</div>
                <div class="big-number" id="dailyGoal">$0</div>
                <div class="progress-bar">
                    <div class="progress-fill" id="todayProgress" style="width: 0%"></div>
                    <div class="progress-text" id="todayProgressText">$0 / $0</div>
                </div>
                <div id="todayStatus" class="status-message status-behind">
                    Loading...
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Work Timer -->
            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">⏱️ WORK TIMER</div>
                <div class="timer-display" id="timerDisplay">00:00:00</div>
                <div class="timer-controls">
                    <button class="btn btn-start" id="startBtn" onclick="startTimer()">START</button>
                    <button class="btn btn-stop" id="stopBtn" onclick="stopTimer()" style="display:none">STOP</button>
                    <button class="btn btn-reset" id="resetBtn" onclick="resetTimer()">RESET</button>
                </div>
                <div class="input-group">
                    <label>Hourly Rate ($)</label>
                    <input type="number" id="hourlyRate" value="24" min="0" max="100" step="0.5">
                    <div style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #666; margin-top: 5px;">
                        Set to $0 for leisure/break time
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-item" style="margin-top: 15px;">
                    <div class="stat-value" id="currentSessionEarnings">$0.00</div>
                    <div class="stat-label">Current Session</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- 9-Day Sprint -->
            <div class="card warning">
                <div class="card-title">📊 9-DAY SPRINT</div>
                <div class="big-number" id="totalEarned">$0</div>
                <div style="font-size: 0.9em; color: #999;">of $<span id="totalNeeded">0</span> needed</div>
                <div class="progress-bar">
                    <div class="progress-fill" id="sprintProgress" style="width: 0%"></div>
                    <div class="progress-text" id="sprintProgressText">0%</div>
                </div>
                <div class="stats-grid">
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value" id="daysLeft">0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Days Left</div>
                    </div>

                        <div class="stat-value red" id="remaining">$0</div>

        <!-- Stats Row -->
        <div class="stats-row">

                        <div class="stat-value" id="todayEarnings">$0</div>

                </div>

            <!-- Bills Conveyor -->

        <!-- Tax Savings Tracker (Bottom of Page) -->

            <div class="card-title">💰 TAX RESERVE TRACKING</div>

                    <div class="stat-value" id="taxEarnings">$0</div>

                </div>

                    <div class="stat-value yellow" id="taxReserve">$0</div>
                    <div class="stat-label">Should Save</div>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-item">
                    <div class="stat-value green" id="taxAfter">$0</div>
                    <div class="stat-label">After Taxes</div>
                </div>

                    <div class="stat-value" id="taxRate">30%</div>
                    <div class="stat-label">Reserve Rate</div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div style="margin-top: 15px; padding-top: 15px; border-top: 1px solid #333;">
                <label style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; cursor: pointer; color: #999;">
                    <input type="checkbox" id="taxIncludeInitial" onchange="updateStats()" style="width: auto;">
                    <span>Include Initial Balance ($<span id="taxInitialAmount">0</span>) in tax calculation</span>
                </label>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Add Session Modal -->
    <div class="modal" id="addSessionModal">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">➕ Add Work Session</div>
            <form onsubmit="addManualSession(event)">
                <div class="form-row">

                        <label>Date</label>
                        <input type="date" id="manualDate" required>
                    </div>
                    <div class="input-group">

                        <input type="number" id="manualRate" min="0" max="100" step="0.5" value="24" required>
                    </div>
                </div>

                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Start Time</label>
                        <input type="time" id="manualStartTime" required>
                    </div>
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>End Time</label>

                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row full">

                    <button type="button" class="btn-modal-secondary" onclick="closeAddSessionModal()">Cancel</button>

    </div>

    <!-- Add Bill Modal -->
    <div class="modal" id="addBillModal">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">💸 Add Bill</div>

                        <label>Amount CAD</label>

                        <input type="number" id="billAmountUSD" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="0.00" required>

                        <label>Due Date (optional)</label>
                        <input type="date" id="billDueDate">

                </div>

                    <button type="submit" class="btn-modal-primary">Add Bill</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-modal-secondary" onclick="closeAddBillModal()">Cancel</button>

            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Edit Bill Modal -->
    <div class="modal" id="editBillModal">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">✏️ Edit Bill</div>

                <input type="hidden" id="editBillId">

                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Bill Name</label>
                        <input type="text" id="editBillName" placeholder="e.g., Rent, Utilities" required>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Amount CAD</label>
                        <input type="number" id="editBillAmountCAD" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="0.00" required
                            onchange="autoCalculateEditBillUSD()">
                    </div>
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Amount USD</label>
                        <input type="number" id="editBillAmountUSD" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="0.00" required>

                </div>

                        <input type="date" id="editBillDueDate">

    <!-- Edit Session Modal -->
    <div class="modal" id="editSessionModal">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">✏️ Edit Work Session</div>

                <input type="hidden" id="editSessionId">
                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Date</label>
                        <input type="date" id="editSessionDate" required>
                    </div>
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Start Time</label>
                        <input type="time" id="editSessionTime" required>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="input-group">

                            onchange="calculateEditEarnings()">

                    <div class="input-group">

                    style="margin-top: 15px; padding: 15px; background: #2a2a2a; border-radius: 8px;">

    <!-- Sprint Settings Modal -->
    <div class="modal" id="sprintSettingsModal">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">⚙️ Sprint Settings</div>
            <form onsubmit="saveSprintSettings(event)">
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Sprint End Date & Time</label>
                        <input type="datetime-local" id="sprintEndDate" required>
