            gap: 12px;
            margin-top: 15px;
        }

        .stats-grid.four-col {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
        }

        .stat-item {
            background: #2a2a2a;
            padding: 15px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .stat-value {
            font-size: 1.8em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #00ff88;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .stat-value.red {
            color: #ff3333;
        }

        .stat-value.yellow {
            color: #ffaa00;
        }

        .stat-label {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #999;
            margin-top: 5px;
        }

        /* Status Messages */
        .status-message {
            padding: 12px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            margin: 12px 0;
            font-weight: bold;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .status-behind {
            background: rgba(255, 51, 51, 0.2);
            border: 2px solid #ff3333;
            color: #ff3333;
        }

        .status-ahead {
            background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.2);
            border: 2px solid #00ff88;
            color: #00ff88;
        }

        /* Session History */
        .session-controls {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .session-controls input[type="date"] {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 150px;
            padding: 8px;
            background: #2a2a2a;
            border: 2px solid #444;
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .btn-small {
            padding: 8px 15px;
            font-size: 0.9em;
            font-weight: bold;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-small.primary {
            background: #00ff88;
            color: #000;
        }

        .btn-small.secondary {
            background: #444;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .btn-small:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .session-history {
            max-height: 500px;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }

        .session-item {
            background: #2a2a2a;
            padding: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            transition: background 0.2s;
        }

        .session-item:hover {
            background: #3a3a3a;
        }

        .session-item.leisure {
            background: rgba(255, 51, 51, 0.05);
            border-left: 3px solid #ff3333;
        }

        .session-info {
            flex: 1;
        }

        .session-time {
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 3px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .session-details {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #999;
        }

        .session-note {
            font-size: 0.85em;
            color: #666;
            margin-top: 5px;
            font-style: italic;
        }

        .session-earnings {
            font-size: 1.3em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #00ff88;
            margin: 0 15px;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .session-earnings.negative {
            color: #ff3333;
        }

        .session-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .action-btn {
            padding: 6px 10px;
            background: #2a2a2a;
            border: 1px solid #444;
            color: #fff;
            border-radius: 5px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 0.9em;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .action-btn:hover {
            background: #3a3a3a;
            border-color: #00ff88;
        }

        .action-btn.delete {
            border-color: #ff3333;
            color: #ff3333;
        }

        .action-btn.delete:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 51, 51, 0.1);
        }

        /* Bills Conveyor */
        .bills-track {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 10px;
            max-height: 400px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        .bill-item {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2a0a0a 0%, #1a1a1a 100%);
            border-left: 5px solid #ff3333;
            padding: 15px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            animation: slideIn 0.5s ease-out;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .bill-item::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 0;
            height: 100%;
            width: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 51, 51, 0.1), transparent);
            animation: shimmer 3s infinite;
        }

        .bill-item.urgent {
            border-left-color: #ff0000;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3a0000 0%, #2a0000 100%);
            animation: pulse 2s infinite, slideIn 0.5s ease-out;
        }

        .bill-item.warning {
            border-left-color: #ffaa00;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2a1a00 0%, #1a1a1a 100%);
        }

        .bill-item.paid {
            border-left-color: #00ff88;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a2a1a 0%, #1a1a1a 100%);
            opacity: 0.6;
        }

        @keyframes slideIn {
            from {
                transform: translateX(-20px);
                opacity: 0;
            }

            to {
                transform: translateX(0);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        @keyframes pulse {

            0%,
            100% {
                box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.7);
            }

            50% {
                box-shadow: 0 0 20px 5px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0);
            }
        }

        @keyframes shimmer {
            0% {
                width: 0;
                left: 0;
            }

            50% {
                width: 100%;
                left: 0;
            }

            100% {
                width: 0;
                left: 100%;
            }
        }

        .bill-info {
            flex: 1;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .bill-name {
            font-size: 1.1em;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
        }

        .bill-due {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #999;
        }

        .bill-due.urgent {
            color: #ff3333;
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .bill-amount {
            font-size: 1.5em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #ff3333;
            text-align: right;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            margin: 0 15px;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .bill-amount.paid {
            color: #00ff88;
            text-decoration: line-through;
        }

        .bill-amount-usd {
            font-size: 0.6em;
            color: #999;
            display: block;
        }

        .bills-total {
            margin-top: 15px;
            padding: 15px;
            background: #2a0a0a;
            border-radius: 8px;
            text-align: center;
            border: 2px solid #ff3333;
        }

        .bills-total-label {
            font-size: 1em;
            color: #999;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .bills-total-amount {
            font-size: 2.5em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #ff3333;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        /* Modal */
        .modal {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
            z-index: 2000;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        .modal.show {
            display: flex;
        }

        .modal-content {
            background: #1a1a1a;
            border: 2px solid #333;
            border-radius: 15px;
            padding: 30px;
            max-width: 500px;
            width: 100%;
            max-height: 90vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
            animation: modalSlideIn 0.3s ease-out;
        }

        @keyframes modalSlideIn {
            from {
                transform: translateY(-50px);
                opacity: 0;
            }

            to {
                transform: translateY(0);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        .modal-header {
            font-size: 1.5em;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            color: #00ff88;
        }

        .form-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        .form-row.full {
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }

        .modal-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .btn-modal-primary {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 12px;
            background: #00ff88;
            color: #000;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-modal-primary:hover {
            background: #00cc66;
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .btn-modal-secondary {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 12px;
            background: #444;
            color: #fff;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-modal-secondary:hover {
            background: #555;
        }

        /* Empty States */
        .empty-state {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 40px 20px;
            color: #666;
        }

        .empty-state-icon {
            font-size: 3em;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        /* Date Group Headers */
        .date-group-header {
            background: #2a2a2a;
            padding: 10px 15px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            margin: 20px 0 10px 0;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #00ff88;
        }

        .date-group-stats {
            color: #999;
        }

        /* Loading State */
        .loading {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 40px;
            color: #666;
        }

        .spinner {
            border: 4px solid #2a2a2a;
            border-top: 4px solid #00ff88;
            border-radius: 50%;
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
            margin: 20px auto;
        }

        @keyframes spin {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0deg);
            }

            100% {
                transform: rotate(360deg);
            }
        }

        /* Responsive */
        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .hero-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .stats-row {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .main-content {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .stats-grid.four-col {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .countdown-timer {
                font-size: 2.5em;
            }

            .big-number {
                font-size: 2em;
            }

            .header h1 {
                font-size: 1.8em;
            }

            .form-row {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
        }

        /* Scrollbar Styling */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: #1a1a1a;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #444;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: #555;
        }

        /* Badge */
        .badge {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 2px 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: 0.75em;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-left: 8px;
        }

        .badge.manual {
            background: #444;
            color: #999;
        }

        .badge.leisure {
            background: #ff3333;
            color: #fff;
        }

        /* ===== DEMO MODE STYLES ===== */
        
        .demo-banner {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            z-index: 10000;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1 0%, #8b5cf6 100%);
            color: white;
            padding: 12px 20px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3);
            animation: slideDown 0.3s ease-out;
        }

        @keyframes slideDown {
            from {
                transform: translateY(-100%);
                opacity: 0;
            }
            to {
                transform: translateY(0);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        .demo-banner-content {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 15px;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .demo-banner-icon {
            font-size: 1.5em;
        }

        .demo-banner-text {
            font-weight: 500;
            font-size: 0.95em;
        }

        .demo-banner-btn {
            background: white;
            color: #6366f1;
            border: none;
            padding: 8px 20px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            font-size: 0.9em;
        }

        .demo-banner-btn:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
        }

        .demo-banner-dismiss {
            background: transparent;
            color: white;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
            padding: 4px 12px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            font-size: 0.9em;
            margin-left: auto;
        }

        .demo-banner-dismiss:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        }

        /* Auth Buttons (Top Right) */
        .auth-buttons {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .btn-auth {
            padding: 8px 20px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            font-size: 0.9em;
            border: none;
        }

        .btn-login {
            background: transparent;
            color: #fff;
            border: 2px solid #fff;
        }

        .btn-login:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .btn-register {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00ff88 0%, #00cc66 100%);
            color: #000;
        }

        .btn-register:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.4);
        }

        /* Auth Modals */
        .auth-modal {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            z-index: 10001;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            animation: fadeIn 0.2s ease-out;
        }

        .auth-modal.active {
            display: flex;
        }

        .auth-modal-content {
            background: #1a1a1a;
            border: 2px solid #ff3333;
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 40px;
            width: 90%;
            max-width: 450px;
            position: relative;
            animation: slideUp 0.3s ease-out;
        }

        @keyframes slideUp {
            from {
                transform: translateY(30px);
                opacity: 0;
            }
            to {
                transform: translateY(0);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        .auth-modal-close {
            position: absolute;
            top: 15px;
            right: 20px;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: #999;
            font-size: 1.5em;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 5px;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .auth-modal-close:hover {
            color: #fff;
        }

        /* Responsive Demo Banner */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .demo-banner-content {
                flex-direction: column;
                gap: 10px;
            }

            .demo-banner-text {
                font-size: 0.85em;
                text-align: center;
            }

            .demo-banner-dismiss {
                margin-left: 0;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

<body>
    <div class="container">
        <!-- Header with Burger Menu -->
        <div class="header">
            <div class="header-title">
                <h1>🔥 SURVIVAL MODE 🔥</h1>
                <div class="header-subtitle">Last Day to Work: October 24, 2025</div>
            </div>
            <button class="burger-btn" onclick="toggleBurgerMenu()">☰</button>
        </div>

        <!-- Burger Menu Overlay -->
        <div class="burger-overlay" id="burgerOverlay" onclick="closeBurgerMenu()"></div>

        <!-- Burger Menu -->
        <div class="burger-menu" id="burgerMenu">
            <div class="burger-menu-header">
                <div class="burger-menu-title">Menu</div>
                <button class="burger-close" onclick="closeBurgerMenu()">✕</button>
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="exportData()">
                📥 Export Data (JSON)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="importData()">
                📤 Import Data (JSON)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="exportBillsCSV()">
                📋 Export Bills (CSV)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="importBillsCSV()">
                📂 Import Bills (CSV)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="showSprintSettingsModal()">
                ⚙️ Sprint Settings
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item logout" onclick="handleLogout()">
                🚪 Logout
            </div>
        </div>
        <input type="file" id="importFile" accept=".json" style="display: none;" onchange="handleImport(event)">
        <input type="file" id="importBillsCsvFile" accept=".csv" style="display: none;"
            onchange="handleBillsCsvImport(event)">

        <!-- Countdown Banner -->
        <div class="deadline-countdown">
            <div class="countdown-timer" id="countdown">--:--:--</div>
            <div class="countdown-label">Until Oct 24 Work Deadline</div>
        </div>

        <!-- Hero Dashboard Grid -->
        <div class="hero-grid">
            <!-- Today's Goal -->
            <div class="card critical">
                <div class="card-title">💰 TODAY'S GOAL</div>
                <div class="big-number" id="dailyGoal">$0</div>
                <div class="progress-bar">
                    <div class="progress-fill" id="todayProgress" style="width: 0%"></div>
                    <div class="progress-text" id="todayProgressText">$0 / $0</div>
                </div>
                <div id="todayStatus" class="status-message status-behind">
                    Loading...
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Work Timer -->
            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">⏱️ WORK TIMER</div>
                <div class="timer-display" id="timerDisplay">00:00:00</div>
                <div class="timer-controls">
                    <button class="btn btn-start" id="startBtn" onclick="startTimer()">START</button>
                    <button class="btn btn-stop" id="stopBtn" onclick="stopTimer()" style="display:none">STOP</button>
                    <button class="btn btn-reset" id="resetBtn" onclick="resetTimer()">RESET</button>
                </div>
                <div class="input-group">
                    <label>Hourly Rate ($)</label>
                    <input type="number" id="hourlyRate" value="24" min="0" max="100" step="0.5">
                    <div style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #666; margin-top: 5px;">
                        Set to $0 for leisure/break time
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-item" style="margin-top: 15px;">
                    <div class="stat-value" id="currentSessionEarnings">$0.00</div>
                    <div class="stat-label">Current Session</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- 9-Day Sprint -->
            <div class="card warning">
                <div class="card-title">📊 9-DAY SPRINT</div>
                <div class="big-number" id="totalEarned">$0</div>
                <div style="font-size: 0.9em; color: #999;">of $<span id="totalNeeded">0</span> needed</div>
                <div class="progress-bar">
                    <div class="progress-fill" id="sprintProgress" style="width: 0%"></div>
                    <div class="progress-text" id="sprintProgressText">0%</div>
                </div>
                <div class="stats-grid">
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value" id="daysLeft">0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Days Left</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value red" id="remaining">$0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">To Earn</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Stats Row -->
        <div class="stats-row">
            <!-- Quick Stats -->
            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">📈 QUICK STATS</div>
                <div class="stats-grid">
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value" id="todayHours">0.0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Hours Today</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value" id="todayEarnings">$0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Earned Today</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value" id="hoursNeeded">0.0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Hrs/Day Needed</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value" id="totalHoursNeeded">0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Total Hrs Left</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Bills Breakdown -->
            <div class="card critical">
                <div class="card-title">💸 BILLS BREAKDOWN (CAD → USD)</div>
                <div class="stats-grid four-col">
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value red" id="billsTotalCAD">$0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Total CAD</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value yellow" id="billsTotalUSD">$0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Total USD (~1.4)</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value red" id="billsWithTax">$0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">USD + Tax (33%)</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value" id="billsCovered">0%</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Covered</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Main Content: Sessions + Bills Side by Side -->
        <div class="main-content">
            <!-- Session History -->
            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">📝 SESSION HISTORY</div>
                <div class="session-controls">
                    <input type="date" id="viewDate">
                    <button class="btn-small primary" onclick="viewToday()">Today</button>
                    <button class="btn-small secondary" onclick="viewAllDays()">All</button>
                    <button class="btn-small primary" onclick="showAddSessionModal()">➕ Add Manual Entry</button>
                </div>
                <div class="session-history" id="sessionHistory">
                    <div class="loading">
                        <div class="spinner"></div>
                        Loading sessions...
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Bills Conveyor -->
            <div class="card critical">
                <div class="card-title">💸 BILLS CONVEYOR</div>
                <button class="btn-small primary" style="width: 100%; margin-bottom: 15px;"
                    onclick="showAddBillModal()">➕ Add Bill</button>
                <div class="bills-track" id="billsTrack">
                    <div class="loading">
