        }

        .burger-menu-title {
            font-size: 1.2em;
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .burger-close {
            background: none;
            border: none;
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 1.5em;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 5px;
        }

        .burger-menu-item {
            padding: 15px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            background: #2a2a2a;
            border: 2px solid #333;
            border-radius: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            font-size: 1em;
        }

        .burger-menu-item:hover {
            border-color: #00ff88;
            background: #3a3a3a;
        }

        .burger-menu-item.logout {
            border-color: #ff3333;
            color: #ff3333;
        }

        .burger-menu-item.logout:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 51, 51, 0.1);
        }

        /* Countdown Banner */
        .deadline-countdown {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a1a 0%, #2a0a0a 100%);
            border: 3px solid #ff3333;
            border-radius: 15px;
            padding: 20px;
            margin: 20px 0;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .countdown-timer {
            font-size: 4em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #ff3333;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .countdown-label {
            font-size: 1.2em;
            color: #999;
        }

        /* Hero Dashboard Grid */
        .hero-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 20px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        /* Stats Row */
        .stats-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr;
            gap: 20px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        /* Main Content - Side by Side */
        .main-content {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr;
            gap: 20px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .card {
            background: #1a1a1a;
            border: 2px solid #333;
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        .card.critical {
            border-color: #ff3333;
        }

        .card.warning {
            border-color: #ffaa00;
        }

        .card.success {
            border-color: #00ff88;
        }

        .card-title {
            font-size: 1.3em;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            color: #fff;
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .big-number {
            font-size: 3em;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin: 10px 0;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        /* Progress Bars */
        .progress-bar {
            width: 100%;
            height: 30px;
            background: #2a2a2a;
            border-radius: 15px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin: 12px 0;
            position: relative;
        }

        .progress-fill {
            height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #00ff88 0%, #00cc66 100%);
            transition: width 0.5s ease;
            border-radius: 15px;
        }

        .progress-fill.behind {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff3333 0%, #cc0000 100%);
        }

        .progress-text {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #fff;
            text-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
            font-size: 0.9em;
        }

        /* Timer Controls */
        .timer-display {
            font-size: 3em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #fff;
            text-align: center;
            margin: 20px 0;
            font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .timer-controls {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            margin: 15px 0;
        }

        .btn {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 12px 20px;
            font-size: 1em;
            font-weight: bold;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-start {
            background: #00ff88;
            color: #000;
        }

        .btn-start:hover {
            background: #00cc66;
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .btn-stop {
            background: #ff3333;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .btn-stop:hover {
            background: #cc0000;
        }

        .btn-reset {
            background: #ffaa00;
            color: #000;
        }

        .btn-reset:hover {
            background: #cc8800;
        }

        /* Input Groups */
        .input-group {
            margin: 12px 0;
        }

        .input-group label {
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            color: #999;
            font-size: 0.9em;
        }

        .input-group input {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 10px;
            font-size: 1em;
            background: #2a2a2a;
            border: 2px solid #444;
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .input-group input:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: #00ff88;
        }

        /* Stats Grid */
        .stats-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 12px;
            margin-top: 15px;
        }

        .stats-grid.four-col {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
        }

        .stat-item {
            background: #2a2a2a;
            padding: 15px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .stat-value {
            font-size: 1.8em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #00ff88;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .stat-value.red {
            color: #ff3333;
        }

        .stat-value.yellow {
            color: #ffaa00;
        }

        .stat-label {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #999;
            margin-top: 5px;
        }

        /* Status Messages */
        .status-message {
            padding: 12px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            margin: 12px 0;
            font-weight: bold;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .status-behind {
            background: rgba(255, 51, 51, 0.2);
            border: 2px solid #ff3333;
            color: #ff3333;
        }

        .status-ahead {
            background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.2);
            border: 2px solid #00ff88;
            color: #00ff88;
        }

        /* Session History */
        .session-controls {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .session-controls input[type="date"] {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 150px;
            padding: 8px;
            background: #2a2a2a;
            border: 2px solid #444;
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .btn-small {
            padding: 8px 15px;
            font-size: 0.9em;
            font-weight: bold;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-small.primary {
            background: #00ff88;
            color: #000;
        }

        .btn-small.secondary {
            background: #444;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .btn-small:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .session-history {
            max-height: 500px;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }

        .session-item {
            background: #2a2a2a;
            padding: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            transition: background 0.2s;
        }

        .session-item:hover {
            background: #3a3a3a;
        }

        .session-item.leisure {
            background: rgba(255, 51, 51, 0.05);
            border-left: 3px solid #ff3333;
        }

        .session-info {
            flex: 1;
        }

        .session-time {
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 3px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .session-details {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #999;
        }

        .session-note {
            font-size: 0.85em;
            color: #666;
            margin-top: 5px;
            font-style: italic;
        }

        .session-earnings {
            font-size: 1.3em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #00ff88;
            margin: 0 15px;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .session-earnings.negative {
            color: #ff3333;
        }

        .session-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .action-btn {
            padding: 6px 10px;
            background: #2a2a2a;
            border: 1px solid #444;
            color: #fff;
            border-radius: 5px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 0.9em;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .action-btn:hover {
            background: #3a3a3a;
            border-color: #00ff88;
        }

        .action-btn.delete {
            border-color: #ff3333;
            color: #ff3333;
        }

        .action-btn.delete:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 51, 51, 0.1);
        }

        /* Bills Conveyor */
        .bills-track {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 10px;
            max-height: 400px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        .bill-item {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2a0a0a 0%, #1a1a1a 100%);
            border-left: 5px solid #ff3333;
            padding: 15px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            animation: slideIn 0.5s ease-out;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .bill-item::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 0;
            height: 100%;
            width: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 51, 51, 0.1), transparent);
            animation: shimmer 3s infinite;
        }

        .bill-item.urgent {
            border-left-color: #ff0000;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3a0000 0%, #2a0000 100%);
            animation: pulse 2s infinite, slideIn 0.5s ease-out;
        }

        .bill-item.warning {
            border-left-color: #ffaa00;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2a1a00 0%, #1a1a1a 100%);
        }

        .bill-item.paid {
            border-left-color: #00ff88;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a2a1a 0%, #1a1a1a 100%);
            opacity: 0.6;
        }

        @keyframes slideIn {
            from {
                transform: translateX(-20px);
                opacity: 0;
            }

            to {
                transform: translateX(0);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        @keyframes pulse {

            0%,
            100% {
                box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.7);
            }

            50% {
                box-shadow: 0 0 20px 5px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0);
            }
        }

        @keyframes shimmer {
            0% {
                width: 0;
                left: 0;
            }

            50% {
                width: 100%;
                left: 0;
            }

            100% {
                width: 0;
                left: 100%;
            }
        }

        .bill-info {
            flex: 1;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .bill-name {
            font-size: 1.1em;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
        }

        .bill-due {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #999;
        }

        .bill-due.urgent {
            color: #ff3333;
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .bill-amount {
            font-size: 1.5em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #ff3333;
            text-align: right;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            margin: 0 15px;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .bill-amount.paid {
            color: #00ff88;
            text-decoration: line-through;
        }

        .bill-amount-usd {
            font-size: 0.6em;
            color: #999;
            display: block;
        }

        .bills-total {
            margin-top: 15px;
            padding: 15px;
            background: #2a0a0a;
            border-radius: 8px;
            text-align: center;
            border: 2px solid #ff3333;
        }

        .bills-total-label {
            font-size: 1em;
            color: #999;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .bills-total-amount {
            font-size: 2.5em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #ff3333;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        /* Modal */
        .modal {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
            z-index: 2000;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        .modal.show {
            display: flex;
        }

        .modal-content {
            background: #1a1a1a;
            border: 2px solid #333;
            border-radius: 15px;
            padding: 30px;
            max-width: 500px;
            width: 100%;
            max-height: 90vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
            animation: modalSlideIn 0.3s ease-out;
        }

        @keyframes modalSlideIn {
            from {
                transform: translateY(-50px);
                opacity: 0;
            }

            to {
                transform: translateY(0);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        .modal-header {
            font-size: 1.5em;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            color: #00ff88;
        }

        .form-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        .form-row.full {
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }

        .modal-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .btn-modal-primary {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 12px;
            background: #00ff88;
            color: #000;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-modal-primary:hover {
            background: #00cc66;
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .btn-modal-secondary {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 12px;
            background: #444;
            color: #fff;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-modal-secondary:hover {
            background: #555;
        }

        /* Empty States */
        .empty-state {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 40px 20px;
            color: #666;
        }

        .empty-state-icon {
            font-size: 3em;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        /* Date Group Headers */
        .date-group-header {
            background: #2a2a2a;
            padding: 10px 15px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            margin: 20px 0 10px 0;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #00ff88;
        }

        .date-group-stats {
            color: #999;
        }

        /* Loading State */
        .loading {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 40px;
            color: #666;
        }

        .spinner {
            border: 4px solid #2a2a2a;
            border-top: 4px solid #00ff88;
            border-radius: 50%;
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
            margin: 20px auto;
        }

        @keyframes spin {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0deg);
            }

            100% {
                transform: rotate(360deg);
            }
        }

        /* Responsive */
        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .hero-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .stats-row {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .main-content {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .stats-grid.four-col {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .countdown-timer {
                font-size: 2.5em;
            }

            .big-number {
                font-size: 2em;
            }

            .header h1 {
                font-size: 1.8em;
            }

            .form-row {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
        }

        /* Scrollbar Styling */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: #1a1a1a;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #444;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: #555;
        }

        /* Badge */
        .badge {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 2px 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: 0.75em;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-left: 8px;
        }

        .badge.manual {
            background: #444;
            color: #999;
        }

        .badge.leisure {
            background: #ff3333;
            color: #fff;
        }

        /* ===== DEMO MODE STYLES ===== */
        
        .demo-banner {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            z-index: 10000;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1 0%, #8b5cf6 100%);
            color: white;
            padding: 12px 20px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3);
            animation: slideDown 0.3s ease-out;
        }

        @keyframes slideDown {
            from {
                transform: translateY(-100%);
                opacity: 0;
            }
            to {
                transform: translateY(0);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        .demo-banner-content {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 15px;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .demo-banner-icon {
            font-size: 1.5em;
        }

        .demo-banner-text {
            font-weight: 500;
            font-size: 0.95em;
        }

        .demo-banner-btn {
            background: white;
            color: #6366f1;
            border: none;
            padding: 8px 20px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            font-size: 0.9em;
        }

        .demo-banner-btn:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
        }

        .demo-banner-dismiss {
            background: transparent;
            color: white;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
            padding: 4px 12px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            font-size: 0.9em;
            margin-left: auto;
        }

        .demo-banner-dismiss:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        }

        /* Auth Buttons (Top Right) */
        .auth-buttons {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .btn-auth {
            padding: 8px 20px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            font-size: 0.9em;
            border: none;
        }

        .btn-login {
            background: transparent;
            color: #fff;
            border: 2px solid #fff;
        }

        .btn-login:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .btn-register {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00ff88 0%, #00cc66 100%);
            color: #000;
        }

        .btn-register:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.4);
        }

        /* Auth Modals */
        .auth-modal {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            z-index: 10001;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            animation: fadeIn 0.2s ease-out;
        }

        .auth-modal.active {
            display: flex;
        }

        .auth-modal-content {
            background: #1a1a1a;
            border: 2px solid #ff3333;
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 40px;
            width: 90%;
            max-width: 450px;
            position: relative;
            animation: slideUp 0.3s ease-out;
        }

        @keyframes slideUp {
            from {
                transform: translateY(30px);
                opacity: 0;
            }
            to {
                transform: translateY(0);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        .auth-modal-close {
            position: absolute;
            top: 15px;
            right: 20px;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: #999;
            font-size: 1.5em;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 5px;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .auth-modal-close:hover {
            color: #fff;
        }

        /* Responsive Demo Banner */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .demo-banner-content {
                flex-direction: column;
                gap: 10px;
            }

            .demo-banner-text {
                font-size: 0.85em;
                text-align: center;
            }

            .demo-banner-dismiss {
                margin-left: 0;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

<body>
    <div class="container">
        <!-- Header with Burger Menu -->
        <div class="header">
            <div class="header-title">
                <h1>🔥 SURVIVAL MODE 🔥</h1>
                <div class="header-subtitle">Last Day to Work: October 24, 2025</div>
            </div>
            <button class="burger-btn" onclick="toggleBurgerMenu()">☰</button>
        </div>

        <!-- Burger Menu Overlay -->
        <div class="burger-overlay" id="burgerOverlay" onclick="closeBurgerMenu()"></div>

        <!-- Burger Menu -->
        <div class="burger-menu" id="burgerMenu">
            <div class="burger-menu-header">
                <div class="burger-menu-title">Menu</div>
                <button class="burger-close" onclick="closeBurgerMenu()">✕</button>
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="exportData()">
                📥 Export Data (JSON)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="importData()">
                📤 Import Data (JSON)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="exportBillsCSV()">
                📋 Export Bills (CSV)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="importBillsCSV()">
                📂 Import Bills (CSV)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="showSprintSettingsModal()">
                ⚙️ Sprint Settings
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item logout" onclick="handleLogout()">
                🚪 Logout
            </div>
        </div>
        <input type="file" id="importFile" accept=".json" style="display: none;" onchange="handleImport(event)">
        <input type="file" id="importBillsCsvFile" accept=".csv" style="display: none;"
            onchange="handleBillsCsvImport(event)">

        <!-- Countdown Banner -->
        <div class="deadline-countdown">

    <script src="js/api.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Global State
        let DEADLINE = new Date('2025-10-24T23:59:59');
        let TOTAL_NEEDED = 2945;
        let userSettings = null;
        let currentUser = null;
        let timerInterval = null;
        let timerSeconds = 0;
        let isTimerRunning = false;
        let sessions = [];
        let bills = [];
        let isDemoMode = false;

        // ===== DEMO MODE: Fake Data Generators =====
        
        function generateRandomSessions() {
            const sessions = [];
            const today = new Date();
            const names = [
                'Client Website', 
                'App Development', 
                'Consulting Call', 
                'Bug Fixes', 
                'Code Review',
                'Feature Implementation',
                'Database Migration',
                'UI/UX Design',
                'API Integration',
                'Testing & QA'
            ];
            const rates = [45, 55, 65, 75, 85, 95];
            
            // Generate 15-25 sessions over last 14 days
            const sessionCount = Math.floor(Math.random() * 11) + 15;
            
            for (let i = 0; i < sessionCount; i++) {
                const daysAgo = Math.floor(Math.random() * 14);
                const date = new Date(today.getTime() - daysAgo * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
                const hours = (Math.random() * 6 + 1).toFixed(2); // 1-7 hours
                const rate = rates[Math.floor(Math.random() * rates.length)];
                const earnings = (parseFloat(hours) * rate).toFixed(2);
                
                // Random time of day
                date.setHours(Math.floor(Math.random() * 12) + 8); // 8am-8pm
                date.setMinutes(Math.floor(Math.random() * 60));
                
                sessions.push({
                    id: `demo-session-${i}`,
                    time_display: date.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' }),
                    timestamp: date.toISOString(),
                    date: date.toISOString().split('T')[0],
                    hours: parseFloat(hours),
                    rate: parseFloat(rate),
                    earnings: parseFloat(earnings),
                    note: names[Math.floor(Math.random() * names.length)],
                    is_leisure: false,
                    opportunity_cost: 0,
                    is_manual: true,
                    created_at: date.toISOString(),
                    updated_at: date.toISOString()
                });
            }
            
            return sessions.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp) - new Date(a.timestamp));
        }

        function generateRandomBills() {
            const billTypes = [
                { name: 'Rent', cadRange: [1200, 2500], usdFactor: 0.7143 },
                { name: 'Groceries', cadRange: [150, 400], usdFactor: 0.7143 },
                { name: 'Utilities', cadRange: [80, 200], usdFactor: 0.7143 },
                { name: 'Internet', cadRange: [60, 120], usdFactor: 0.7143 },
                { name: 'Phone Bill', cadRange: [30, 80], usdFactor: 0.7143 },
                { name: 'Credit Card', cadRange: [100, 800], usdFactor: 0.7143 },
                { name: 'Insurance', cadRange: [150, 400], usdFactor: 0.7143 },
                { name: 'Gas/Fuel', cadRange: [50, 150], usdFactor: 0.7143 },
                { name: 'Subscription Services', cadRange: [15, 80], usdFactor: 0.7143 },
                { name: 'Student Loan', cadRange: [200, 600], usdFactor: 0.7143 }
            ];
            
            const bills = [];
            const billCount = Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 7; // 7-12 bills
            const usedTypes = new Set();
            
            for (let i = 0; i < billCount; i++) {
                // Pick a unique bill type
                let billType;
                do {
                    billType = billTypes[Math.floor(Math.random() * billTypes.length)];
                } while (usedTypes.has(billType.name) && usedTypes.size < billTypes.length);
                usedTypes.add(billType.name);
                
                const amountCAD = (Math.random() * (billType.cadRange[1] - billType.cadRange[0]) + billType.cadRange[0]).toFixed(2);
                const amountUSD = (amountCAD * billType.usdFactor).toFixed(2);
                const daysUntilDue = Math.floor(Math.random() * 30) - 5; // -5 to +25 days
                const dueDate = new Date(Date.now() + daysUntilDue * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
                const paid = daysUntilDue < 0 ? (Math.random() > 0.3) : false; // 70% of past bills are paid
                
                bills.push({
                    id: `demo-bill-${i}`,
                    name: billType.name,
                    amount_cad: parseFloat(amountCAD),
                    amount_usd: parseFloat(amountUSD),
                    due_date: dueDate.toISOString().split('T')[0],
                    paid: paid,
                    paid_at: paid ? new Date(dueDate.getTime() - Math.random() * 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString() : null,
                    created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
                    updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
                });
            }
            
            return bills.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.due_date) - new Date(b.due_date));
        }

        function generateDemoSettings() {
            const sprintEnd = new Date(Date.now() + 9 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000); // 9 days from now
            const hourlyRates = [45, 55, 65, 75, 85];
            const taxRates = [25, 30, 35];
            const initialBalances = [200, 300, 400, 500, 600];
            
            return {
                sprint_end_date: sprintEnd.toISOString(),
                target_bills_mode: 'auto_unpaid',
                target_bills_manual: 0,
                initial_balance: initialBalances[Math.floor(Math.random() * initialBalances.length)],
                initial_balance_currency: Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'USD' : 'CAD',
                default_hourly_rate: hourlyRates[Math.floor(Math.random() * hourlyRates.length)],
                tax_reserve_rate: taxRates[Math.floor(Math.random() * taxRates.length)],
                exchange_rate_cad_to_usd: 0.7143
            };
        }

        function isDemoModeActive() {
            return !localStorage.getItem('authToken');
        }

        // ===== DEMO MODE: SessionStorage CRUD Wrappers =====

        function saveDemoData() {
            if (isDemoMode) {
                sessionStorage.setItem('demoSessions', JSON.stringify(sessions));
                sessionStorage.setItem('demoBills', JSON.stringify(bills));
                sessionStorage.setItem('demoSettings', JSON.stringify(userSettings));
            }
        }

        async function demo_createSession(sessionData) {
            sessionData.id = `demo-session-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
            sessionData.created_at = new Date().toISOString();
            sessionData.updated_at = new Date().toISOString();
            sessions.unshift(sessionData);
            saveDemoData();
            return sessionData;
        }

        async function demo_updateSession(id, sessionData) {
            const index = sessions.findIndex(s => s.id === id);
            if (index !== -1) {
                sessions[index] = { ...sessions[index], ...sessionData, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() };
                saveDemoData();
                return sessions[index];
            }
            throw new Error('Session not found');
        }

        async function demo_deleteSession(id) {
            const index = sessions.findIndex(s => s.id === id);
            if (index !== -1) {
                sessions.splice(index, 1);
                saveDemoData();
            }
        }

        async function demo_createBill(billData) {
            billData.id = `demo-bill-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
            billData.created_at = new Date().toISOString();
            billData.updated_at = new Date().toISOString();
            billData.paid = false;
            billData.paid_at = null;
            bills.push(billData);
            saveDemoData();
            return billData;
        }

        async function demo_updateBill(id, billData) {
            const index = bills.findIndex(b => b.id === id);
            if (index !== -1) {
                bills[index] = { ...bills[index], ...billData, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() };
                saveDemoData();
                return bills[index];
            }
            throw new Error('Bill not found');
        }

        async function demo_markBillPaid(id, paid) {
            const index = bills.findIndex(b => b.id === id);
            if (index !== -1) {
                bills[index].paid = paid;
                bills[index].paid_at = paid ? new Date().toISOString() : null;
                bills[index].updated_at = new Date().toISOString();
                saveDemoData();
                return bills[index];
            }
            throw new Error('Bill not found');
        }

        async function demo_deleteBill(id) {
            const index = bills.findIndex(b => b.id === id);
            if (index !== -1) {
                bills.splice(index, 1);
                saveDemoData();
            }
        }

        async function demo_updateSettings(settingsData) {
            userSettings = { ...userSettings, ...settingsData };
            DEADLINE = new Date(userSettings.sprint_end_date);
            saveDemoData();
            return userSettings;
        }

        // ===== DEMO MODE: Load Demo Data =====
        
        function loadDemoMode() {
            console.log('🎭 Loading Demo Mode...');
            isDemoMode = true;
            
            // Check if we have demo data in sessionStorage
            const storedSessions = sessionStorage.getItem('demoSessions');
            const storedBills = sessionStorage.getItem('demoBills');
            const storedSettings = sessionStorage.getItem('demoSettings');
            
            if (storedSessions && storedBills && storedSettings) {
                // Load existing demo data from this session
                sessions = JSON.parse(storedSessions);
                bills = JSON.parse(storedBills);
                userSettings = JSON.parse(storedSettings);
                console.log('📦 Loaded demo data from session storage');
            } else {
                // Generate fresh demo data
                sessions = generateRandomSessions();
                bills = generateRandomBills();
                userSettings = generateDemoSettings();
                
                // Store in sessionStorage
                sessionStorage.setItem('demoSessions', JSON.stringify(sessions));
                sessionStorage.setItem('demoBills', JSON.stringify(bills));
                sessionStorage.setItem('demoSettings', JSON.stringify(userSettings));
                console.log('✨ Generated fresh demo data');
            }
            
            // Update DEADLINE from demo settings
            DEADLINE = new Date(userSettings.sprint_end_date);
            
            // Recalculate target and render
            recalculateTarget();
            renderSessions();
            renderBills();
            updateStats();
            
            // Show demo banner and auth buttons
            showDemoModeBanner();
            showAuthButtons();
            
            // Initialize timers
            initializeTimers();
            
            console.log(`🎭 Demo Mode Active: ${sessions.length} sessions, ${bills.length} bills`);
        }

        function showDemoModeBanner() {
            const banner = document.createElement('div');
            banner.id = 'demoBanner';
            banner.className = 'demo-banner';
            banner.innerHTML = `
                <div class="demo-banner-content">
                    <span class="demo-banner-icon">🎭</span>
                    <span class="demo-banner-text">DEMO MODE - You're trying out the app! Data won't be saved.</span>
                    <button class="demo-banner-btn" onclick="showRegisterModal()">Create Account</button>
                    <button class="demo-banner-dismiss" onclick="dismissDemoBanner()">✖</button>
                </div>
            `;
            document.body.insertBefore(banner, document.body.firstChild);
        }

        function dismissDemoBanner() {
            const banner = document.getElementById('demoBanner');
            if (banner) {
                banner.style.display = 'none';
            }
        }

        function showAuthButtons() {
            // Replace burger menu with auth buttons
            const burgerBtn = document.querySelector('.burger-btn');
            if (burgerBtn) {
                burgerBtn.style.display = 'none';
            }
            
            const authButtons = document.createElement('div');
            authButtons.className = 'auth-buttons';
            authButtons.innerHTML = `
                <button class="btn-auth btn-login" onclick="showLoginModal()">Login</button>
                <button class="btn-auth btn-register" onclick="showRegisterModal()">Register</button>
            `;
            
            const header = document.querySelector('.header-top');
            if (header) {
                header.appendChild(authButtons);
            }
        }

        function showUserMenu() {
            const burgerBtn = document.querySelector('.burger-btn');
            if (burgerBtn) {
                burgerBtn.style.display = 'block';
            }
            
            const authButtons = document.querySelector('.auth-buttons');
            if (authButtons) {
                authButtons.remove();
            }
        }

        // Auth Check & Initialization
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
            const token = localStorage.getItem('authToken');
            
            if (!token) {
                // No token = Load demo mode
                loadDemoMode();
                return;
            }

            // Has token = Try to load user data
            try {
                currentUser = await window.api.getProfile();
                await loadDashboardData();
                initializeTimers();
                showUserMenu();
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Auth error:', error);
                // Token invalid = Clear it and load demo mode
                localStorage.removeItem('authToken');
                loadDemoMode();
            }
        });

        function initializeTimers() {
            setInterval(updateCountdown, 1000);
            updateCountdown();

            const today = new Date();
            const manualDateEl = document.getElementById('manualDate');
            const viewDateEl = document.getElementById('viewDate');
            if (manualDateEl) manualDateEl.valueAsDate = today;
            if (viewDateEl) viewDateEl.valueAsDate = today;
        }

        // Load All Dashboard Data
        async function loadDashboardData() {
            // Load settings and data, then recalculate target
            await loadSettings();
            await Promise.all([
                loadSessions(),
                loadBills(),
                loadStats()
            ]);
            // Recalculate target AFTER bills are loaded
            recalculateTarget();
        }

        async function loadSettings() {
            try {
                userSettings = await window.api.getSettings();

                // Update DEADLINE based on settings
                DEADLINE = new Date(userSettings.sprint_end_date);

                // Update deadline display
                const deadlineStr = DEADLINE.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
                    year: 'numeric',
                    month: 'long',
                    day: 'numeric'
                });
                const subtitleEl = document.querySelector('.header-subtitle');
                if (subtitleEl) {
                    subtitleEl.textContent = `Last Day to Work: ${deadlineStr}`;
                }

                // Update countdown label
                const countdownLabel = document.querySelector('.countdown-label');
                if (countdownLabel) {
                    countdownLabel.textContent = `Until ${deadlineStr} Work Deadline`;
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error loading settings:', error);
                // Use defaults if settings fail to load
            }
        }

        function recalculateTarget() {
            if (!userSettings) {
                console.warn('Settings not loaded yet');
                return;
            }

            if (!Array.isArray(bills)) {
                console.warn('Bills not loaded yet');
                TOTAL_NEEDED = 0;
                return;
            }

            // Calculate TOTAL_NEEDED based on settings (AFTER bills are loaded)
            try {
                if (userSettings.target_bills_mode === 'manual') {
                    TOTAL_NEEDED = userSettings.target_bills_manual || 0;
                } else if (userSettings.target_bills_mode === 'auto_all') {
                    TOTAL_NEEDED = bills.reduce((sum, bill) => sum + parseFloat(bill.amount_usd || 0), 0);
                } else { // auto_unpaid (default)
                    TOTAL_NEEDED = bills.filter(b => !b.paid).reduce((sum, bill) => sum + parseFloat(bill.amount_usd || 0), 0);
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error calculating target:', error);
                TOTAL_NEEDED = 0;
            }
        }

        // Countdown Timer
        function updateCountdown() {
            const now = new Date();
            const diff = DEADLINE - now;
            const countdownEl = document.getElementById('countdown');

            if (!countdownEl) return;

            if (diff <= 0) {
                countdownEl.textContent = 'DEADLINE PASSED';
                return;
            }

            const days = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
            const hours = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
            const minutes = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
            const seconds = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);

            countdownEl.textContent = `${days}d ${String(hours).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(seconds).padStart(2, '0')}`;
        }

        // Work Timer Functions
        function startTimer() {
            if (!isTimerRunning) {
                isTimerRunning = true;
                document.getElementById('startBtn').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('stopBtn').style.display = 'block';

                timerInterval = setInterval(() => {
                    timerSeconds++;
                    updateTimerDisplay();
                    updateCurrentSessionEarnings();
                }, 1000);
            }
        }

        function stopTimer() {
            if (isTimerRunning) {
                isTimerRunning = false;
                clearInterval(timerInterval);
                document.getElementById('startBtn').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('stopBtn').style.display = 'none';
                logSession();
            }
        }

        function resetTimer() {
            if (isTimerRunning) stopTimer();
            timerSeconds = 0;
            updateTimerDisplay();
            updateCurrentSessionEarnings();
        }

        function updateTimerDisplay() {
            const hours = Math.floor(timerSeconds / 3600);
            const minutes = Math.floor((timerSeconds % 3600) / 60);
            const seconds = timerSeconds % 60;
            const timerDisplayEl = document.getElementById('timerDisplay');
            if (timerDisplayEl) {
                timerDisplayEl.textContent = `${String(hours).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(seconds).padStart(2, '0')}`;
            }
        }

        function updateCurrentSessionEarnings() {
            const rateEl = document.getElementById('hourlyRate');
            if (!rateEl) return;
            const rate = parseFloat(rateEl.value);
            const hours = timerSeconds / 3600;
            const earnings = hours * rate;
            const earningsEl = document.getElementById('currentSessionEarnings');
            if (earningsEl) earningsEl.textContent = `$${earnings.toFixed(2)}`;
        }

        async function logSession() {
            if (timerSeconds === 0) return;

            const rateEl = document.getElementById('hourlyRate');
            if (!rateEl) return;

            const rate = parseFloat(rateEl.value);
            const hours = timerSeconds / 3600;
            const earnings = hours * rate;
            const isLeisure = rate === 0;
            const opportunityCost = isLeisure ? hours * 24 : 0;
            const note = prompt('Add a note for this session (optional):') || '';

            const startTime = new Date(Date.now() - timerSeconds * 1000);
            const endTime = new Date();

            const sessionData = {
                time_display: `${startTime.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true })} - ${endTime.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true })}`,
                timestamp: startTime.toISOString(),
                date: startTime.toISOString().split('T')[0],
                hours: parseFloat(hours.toFixed(2)),
                rate: rate,
                earnings: parseFloat(earnings.toFixed(2)),
                note: note,
                is_leisure: isLeisure,
                opportunity_cost: parseFloat(opportunityCost.toFixed(2)),
                is_manual: false
            };

            try {
                await window.api.createSession(sessionData);
                await loadDashboardData();

                timerSeconds = 0;
                updateTimerDisplay();
                updateCurrentSessionEarnings();
            } catch (error) {
                alert('Error saving session: ' + error.message);
            }
        }

        // Load Sessions
        async function loadSessions() {
            try {
                sessions = await window.api.getSessions();
                updateSessionHistory();
                updateStats();
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error loading sessions:', error);
                document.getElementById('sessionHistory').innerHTML = `
                    <div class="empty-state">
                        <p style="color: #dc3545;">Error loading sessions</p>
                    </div>
                `;
            }
        }

        // Load Bills
        async function loadBills() {
            try {
                bills = await window.api.getBills();
                renderBills();
                updateStats();
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error loading bills:', error);
                document.getElementById('billsTrack').innerHTML = `
                    <div class="empty-state">
                        <p style="color: #dc3545;">Error loading bills</p>
                    </div>
                `;
            }
        }

        // Render Bills with Urgency
        function renderBills() {
            const now = new Date();
            const track = document.getElementById('billsTrack');
            if (!track) return;

            if (bills.length === 0) {
                track.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="empty-state">
                        <div class="empty-state-icon">📭</div>
                        <p>No bills tracked yet</p>
                    </div>
                `;
                return;
            }

            const sortedBills = [...bills].sort((a, b) => {
                if (a.paid && !b.paid) return 1;
                if (!a.paid && b.paid) return -1;
                if (!a.due_date) return 1;
                if (!b.due_date) return -1;
                return new Date(a.due_date) - new Date(b.due_date);
            });

            track.innerHTML = sortedBills.map(bill => {
                const dueDate = bill.due_date ? new Date(bill.due_date) : null;
                // Check if date is valid
                const isValidDate = dueDate && !isNaN(dueDate.getTime());
                const daysUntil = isValidDate ? Math.ceil((dueDate - now) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) : null;
                let urgencyClass = '';
                let dueText = '';

                if (bill.paid) {
                    urgencyClass = 'paid';
                    dueText = '✅ PAID';
                } else if (!isValidDate) {
                    urgencyClass = '';
                    dueText = 'No due date';
                } else if (daysUntil < 0) {
                    urgencyClass = 'urgent';
                    dueText = `⚠️ OVERDUE by ${Math.abs(daysUntil)} days`;
                } else if (daysUntil === 0) {
                    urgencyClass = 'urgent';
                    dueText = '🔴 DUE TODAY';
                } else if (daysUntil <= 3) {
                    urgencyClass = 'urgent';
                    dueText = `🔴 Due in ${daysUntil} days`;
                } else if (daysUntil <= 7) {
                    urgencyClass = 'warning';
                    dueText = `🟡 Due in ${daysUntil} days`;
                } else {
                    dueText = `Due ${dueDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })}`;
                }

                return `
                    <div class="bill-item ${urgencyClass}">
                        <div class="bill-info">
                            <div class="bill-name">${bill.name}</div>
                            <div class="bill-due ${urgencyClass === 'urgent' || urgencyClass === 'warning' ? 'urgent' : ''}">${dueText}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="bill-amount ${bill.paid ? 'paid' : ''}">
                            $${parseFloat(bill.amount_cad).toFixed(2)}
                            <span class="bill-amount-usd">~$${Math.round(parseFloat(bill.amount_usd))} USD</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="session-actions">
                            <button class="action-btn" onclick="editBill(${bill.id})">✏️</button>
                            <button class="action-btn" onclick="toggleBillPaid(${bill.id}, ${!bill.paid})">${bill.paid ? '❌' : '✅'}</button>
                            <button class="action-btn delete" onclick="deleteBill(${bill.id})">🗑️</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('');

            const totalUnpaidCAD = sortedBills.filter(b => !b.paid).reduce((sum, b) => sum + parseFloat(b.amount_cad || 0), 0);
            const totalUnpaidUSD = sortedBills.filter(b => !b.paid).reduce((sum, b) => sum + parseFloat(b.amount_usd || 0), 0);
            const billsTotalEl = document.getElementById('billsTotal');
            if (billsTotalEl) {
                billsTotalEl.innerHTML = `$${totalUnpaidCAD.toFixed(2)} <span style="font-size: 0.6em; color: #999; display: block; margin-top: 5px;">(~$${totalUnpaidUSD.toFixed(2)} USD)</span>`;
            }
        }

        // Update Session History
        function updateSessionHistory() {
            const container = document.getElementById('sessionHistory');
            if (!container) return;

            const viewDateInput = document.getElementById('viewDate');
            const viewDateValue = viewDateInput ? viewDateInput.value : null;

            let filteredSessions = sessions;
            let viewingAll = false;

            if (viewDateValue) {
                const viewDate = new Date(viewDateValue).toDateString();
                filteredSessions = sessions.filter(s => new Date(s.timestamp).toDateString() === viewDate);
            } else {
                viewingAll = true;
            }

            if (filteredSessions.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-state"><div class="empty-state-icon">📭</div><p>${viewingAll ? 'No sessions logged yet' : 'No sessions on this date'}</p></div>`;
                return;
            }

            if (viewingAll) {
                const sessionsByDate = {};
                filteredSessions.forEach(s => {
                    const date = new Date(s.timestamp).toDateString();
                    if (!sessionsByDate[date]) sessionsByDate[date] = [];
                    sessionsByDate[date].push(s);
                });

                container.innerHTML = Object.keys(sessionsByDate)
                    .sort((a, b) => new Date(b) - new Date(a))
                    .map(date => {
                        const dateSessions = sessionsByDate[date];
                        const totalHours = dateSessions.reduce((sum, s) => sum + parseFloat(s.hours), 0);
                        const totalEarnings = dateSessions.filter(s => !s.is_leisure).reduce((sum, s) => sum + parseFloat(s.earnings), 0);

                        return `
                            <div class="date-group-header">
                                <span>${new Date(date).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })}</span>
                                <span class="date-group-stats">${totalHours.toFixed(1)}h • $${totalEarnings.toFixed(0)}</span>
                            </div>
                            ${renderSessionItems(dateSessions)}
                        `;
                    }).join('');
            } else {
                container.innerHTML = renderSessionItems(filteredSessions);
            }
        }

        function renderSessionItems(sessionList) {
            return sessionList.map((s) => {
                const isLeisure = s.rate === 0 || s.is_leisure;
                const displayEarnings = isLeisure ?
                    `-$${(s.opportunity_cost || (parseFloat(s.hours) * 24)).toFixed(2)}` :
                    `$${parseFloat(s.earnings).toFixed(2)}`;

                return `
                    <div class="session-item ${isLeisure ? 'leisure' : ''}">
                        <div class="session-info">
                            <div class="session-time">
                                ${s.time_display || new Date(s.timestamp).toLocaleString()}
                                ${isLeisure ? '<span style="font-size: 1.2em;">🎮</span>' : ''}
                                ${s.is_manual ? '<span class="badge manual">MANUAL</span>' : ''}
                            </div>
                            <div class="session-details">${s.hours}h @ $${s.rate}/hr</div>
                            ${s.note ? `<div class="session-note">${s.note}</div>` : ''}
                        </div>
                        <div class="session-earnings ${isLeisure ? 'negative' : ''}">${displayEarnings}</div>
                        <div class="session-actions">
                            <button class="action-btn" onclick="editSession(${s.id})">✏️</button>
                            <button class="action-btn delete" onclick="deleteSession(${s.id})">🗑️</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('');
        }

        function viewToday() {
            const viewDateEl = document.getElementById('viewDate');
            if (viewDateEl) viewDateEl.valueAsDate = new Date();
            updateSessionHistory();
        }

        function viewAllDays() {
            const viewDateEl = document.getElementById('viewDate');
            if (viewDateEl) viewDateEl.value = '';
            updateSessionHistory();
        }

        // Load and Update Stats
        async function loadStats() {
            try {
                const stats = await window.api.getStats();
                const todayStats = await window.api.getTodayStats();

                TOTAL_NEEDED = stats.totalTarget;

                updateStatsDisplay(stats, todayStats);
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error loading stats:', error);
            }
        }

        function updateStats() {
            try {
                // Guard clause - ensure data is loaded
                if (!Array.isArray(sessions) || !Array.isArray(bills)) {
                    console.warn('Data not loaded yet, skipping stats update');
                    return;
                }

                if (sessions.length === 0 && bills.length === 0) return;

                const today = new Date().toDateString();
                const todaySessions = sessions.filter(s => s.timestamp && new Date(s.timestamp).toDateString() === today);

                const todayHours = todaySessions.reduce((sum, s) => sum + parseFloat(s.hours || 0), 0);
                const todayEarnings = todaySessions.filter(s => !s.is_leisure).reduce((sum, s) => sum + parseFloat(s.earnings || 0), 0);

                // Calculate total earned from sessions + initial balance
                const sessionsEarned = sessions.filter(s => !s.is_leisure).reduce((sum, s) => sum + parseFloat(s.earnings || 0), 0);

                // Parse initial balance with multiple fallbacks
                let initialBalance = 0;
                if (userSettings && userSettings.initial_balance != null) {
                    console.log('🔍 Initial Balance Debug:', {
                        raw: userSettings.initial_balance,
                        type: typeof userSettings.initial_balance,
                        currency: userSettings.initial_balance_currency
                    });
                    const parsed = parseFloat(userSettings.initial_balance);
                    initialBalance = (!isNaN(parsed) && isFinite(parsed)) ? parsed : 0;
                    console.log('✅ Parsed initial balance:', initialBalance);
                }

                // Convert initial balance to USD if it's in CAD
                if (initialBalance > 0 && userSettings && userSettings.initial_balance_currency === 'CAD') {
                    const exchangeRate = parseFloat(userSettings.exchange_rate_cad_to_usd);
                    console.log('🔄 Converting CAD to USD:', { before: initialBalance, rate: exchangeRate });
                    if (!isNaN(exchangeRate) && exchangeRate > 0) {
                        initialBalance = initialBalance * exchangeRate;
                        console.log('💱 After conversion:', initialBalance);
                    }
                }

                const totalEarned = sessionsEarned + initialBalance;

                // Calculate bills based on target_bills_mode
                const totalBillsUSD = parseFloat(TOTAL_NEEDED) || 0;
                const totalBillsCAD = bills.filter(b => !b.paid).reduce((sum, b) => sum + parseFloat(b.amount_cad || 0), 0);

                // Use tax reserve rate from settings, default to 30%
                const taxReserveRate = userSettings ? (parseFloat(userSettings.tax_reserve_rate) || 30) : 30;
                const afterTaxMultiplier = 1 / (1 - (taxReserveRate / 100));
                const totalWithTax = totalBillsUSD * afterTaxMultiplier;

                const remaining = Math.max(0, totalWithTax - totalEarned);
                const daysLeft = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((DEADLINE - new Date()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)));
                const dailyGoal = remaining / daysLeft;

                const rateEl = document.getElementById('hourlyRate');
                const defaultRate = userSettings ? (parseFloat(userSettings.default_hourly_rate) || 24) : 24;
                const rate = rateEl ? (parseFloat(rateEl.value) || defaultRate) : defaultRate;
                const hoursPerDay = rate > 0 ? dailyGoal / rate : 0;
                const totalHours = rate > 0 ? remaining / rate : 0;

                // Fix progress bar edge cases
                let progress = 0;
                if (totalWithTax > 0) {
                    progress = Math.min((totalEarned / totalWithTax) * 100, 100);
                } else if (totalEarned > 0) {
                    progress = 100; // If no target but has earnings, show as complete
                }

                let todayProgress = 0;
                if (dailyGoal > 0) {
                    todayProgress = (todayEarnings / dailyGoal) * 100;
                } else if (todayEarnings > 0) {
                    todayProgress = 100; // If no daily goal but has earnings, show as complete
                }

                // Calculate tax tracking
                const taxIncludeInitial = document.getElementById('taxIncludeInitial')?.checked || false;
                const taxEarningsAmount = taxIncludeInitial ? totalEarned : sessionsEarned;
                const taxReserveAmount = taxEarningsAmount * (taxReserveRate / 100);
                const taxAfterAmount = taxEarningsAmount - taxReserveAmount;

                const els = {
                    dailyGoal: document.getElementById('dailyGoal'),
                    todayProgress: document.getElementById('todayProgress'),
                    todayProgressText: document.getElementById('todayProgressText'),
                    todayStatus: document.getElementById('todayStatus'),
                    totalEarned: document.getElementById('totalEarned'),
                    totalNeeded: document.getElementById('totalNeeded'),
                    sprintProgress: document.getElementById('sprintProgress'),
                    sprintProgressText: document.getElementById('sprintProgressText'),
                    remaining: document.getElementById('remaining'),
                    daysLeft: document.getElementById('daysLeft'),
                    todayHours: document.getElementById('todayHours'),
                    todayEarnings: document.getElementById('todayEarnings'),
                    hoursNeeded: document.getElementById('hoursNeeded'),
                    totalHoursNeeded: document.getElementById('totalHoursNeeded'),
                    billsTotalCAD: document.getElementById('billsTotalCAD'),
                    billsTotalUSD: document.getElementById('billsTotalUSD'),
                    billsWithTax: document.getElementById('billsWithTax'),
                    billsCovered: document.getElementById('billsCovered'),
                    taxEarnings: document.getElementById('taxEarnings'),
                    taxReserve: document.getElementById('taxReserve'),
                    taxAfter: document.getElementById('taxAfter'),
                    taxRate: document.getElementById('taxRate'),
                    taxInitialAmount: document.getElementById('taxInitialAmount')
                };

                if (els.dailyGoal) els.dailyGoal.textContent = `$${Math.round(dailyGoal)}`;
                if (els.todayProgress) {
                    els.todayProgress.style.width = Math.min(todayProgress, 100) + '%';
                    els.todayProgress.classList.toggle('behind', todayProgress < 100);
                }
                if (els.todayProgressText) els.todayProgressText.textContent = `$${Math.round(todayEarnings)} / $${Math.round(dailyGoal)}`;

                if (els.todayStatus) {
                    if (todayEarnings >= dailyGoal) {
                        els.todayStatus.textContent = `✅ GOAL MET! +$${(todayEarnings - dailyGoal).toFixed(2)} extra`;
                        els.todayStatus.className = 'status-message status-ahead';
                    } else {
                        const needed = dailyGoal - todayEarnings;
                        els.todayStatus.textContent = `You need $${needed.toFixed(2)} more today`;
                        els.todayStatus.className = 'status-message status-behind';
                    }
                }

                if (els.totalEarned) els.totalEarned.textContent = `$${Math.round(totalEarned)}`;
                if (els.totalNeeded) els.totalNeeded.textContent = Math.round(totalWithTax);

                if (els.sprintProgress) {
                    els.sprintProgress.style.width = Math.min(progress, 100) + '%';
                    // Change color if sprint is complete
                    if (progress >= 100) {
                        els.sprintProgress.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg, #00ff88 0%, #00cc66 100%)';
                    } else {
                        els.sprintProgress.style.background = '';
                    }
                }

                if (els.sprintProgressText) {
                    if (progress >= 100) {
                        els.sprintProgressText.textContent = '🎉 COMPLETE!';
                    } else if (isNaN(progress) || !isFinite(progress)) {
                        els.sprintProgressText.textContent = '0%';
                    } else {
                        els.sprintProgressText.textContent = Math.round(progress) + '%';
                    }
                }

                if (els.remaining) {
                    if (remaining <= 0 && totalEarned > 0) {
                        els.remaining.textContent = `+$${Math.round(totalEarned - totalWithTax)}`;
                        els.remaining.style.color = '#00ff88';
                    } else {
                        els.remaining.textContent = `$${Math.round(remaining)}`;
                        els.remaining.style.color = '';
                    }
                }

                if (els.daysLeft) els.daysLeft.textContent = daysLeft;
                if (els.todayHours) els.todayHours.textContent = todayHours.toFixed(1);
                if (els.todayEarnings) els.todayEarnings.textContent = `$${Math.round(todayEarnings)}`;
                if (els.hoursNeeded) els.hoursNeeded.textContent = hoursPerDay.toFixed(1);
                if (els.totalHoursNeeded) els.totalHoursNeeded.textContent = Math.round(totalHours);

                if (els.billsTotalCAD) els.billsTotalCAD.textContent = `$${Math.round(totalBillsCAD)}`;
                if (els.billsTotalUSD) els.billsTotalUSD.textContent = `$${Math.round(totalBillsUSD)}`;
                if (els.billsWithTax) els.billsWithTax.textContent = `$${Math.round(totalWithTax)}`;
                if (els.billsCovered) els.billsCovered.textContent = `${Math.round(progress)}%`;

                // Update tax tracking
                if (els.taxEarnings) els.taxEarnings.textContent = `$${Math.round(taxEarningsAmount)}`;
                if (els.taxReserve) els.taxReserve.textContent = `$${Math.round(taxReserveAmount)}`;
                if (els.taxAfter) els.taxAfter.textContent = `$${Math.round(taxAfterAmount)}`;
                if (els.taxRate) els.taxRate.textContent = `${taxReserveRate.toFixed(0)}%`;
                if (els.taxInitialAmount) els.taxInitialAmount.textContent = Math.round(initialBalance);
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error in updateStats:', error);
                console.error('Stack:', error.stack);
                // Don't throw - just log and continue
            }
        }

        // Add Manual Session
        async function addManualSession(event) {
            event.preventDefault();

            const dateInput = document.getElementById('manualDate').value;
            const startTime = document.getElementById('manualStartTime').value;
            const endTime = document.getElementById('manualEndTime').value;
            const rate = parseFloat(document.getElementById('manualRate').value);
            const note = document.getElementById('manualNote').value;

            if (!dateInput || !startTime || !endTime) {
                alert('Please fill in Date, Start Time, and End Time');
                return;
            }

            const entryDate = new Date(dateInput);
            const [startHour, startMinute] = startTime.split(':').map(Number);
            const [endHour, endMinute] = endTime.split(':').map(Number);

            let startTotalMinutes = startHour * 60 + startMinute;
            let endTotalMinutes = endHour * 60 + endMinute;
            if (endTotalMinutes <= startTotalMinutes) endTotalMinutes += 24 * 60;

            const hours = (endTotalMinutes - startTotalMinutes) / 60;

            const startTimeFormatted = new Date(entryDate);
            startTimeFormatted.setHours(startHour, startMinute);
            const endTimeFormatted = new Date(entryDate);
            endTimeFormatted.setHours(endHour, endMinute);

            const timeDisplay = `${startTimeFormatted.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true })} - ${endTimeFormatted.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true })}`;

            const isLeisure = rate === 0;
            const earnings = isLeisure ? 0 : hours * rate;
            const opportunityCost = isLeisure ? hours * 24 : 0;

            const sessionData = {
                time_display: timeDisplay,
                timestamp: entryDate.toISOString(),
                date: entryDate.toISOString().split('T')[0],
                hours: parseFloat(hours.toFixed(2)),
                rate: rate,
                earnings: parseFloat(earnings.toFixed(2)),
                note: note,
                is_leisure: isLeisure,
                opportunity_cost: parseFloat(opportunityCost.toFixed(2)),
                is_manual: true
            };

            try {
                await window.api.createSession(sessionData);
                await loadDashboardData();
                closeAddSessionModal();

                // Reset form
                document.getElementById('manualStartTime').value = '';
                document.getElementById('manualEndTime').value = '';
                document.getElementById('manualNote').value = '';
            } catch (error) {
                alert('Error adding session: ' + error.message);
            }
        }
