        async function updateBill(event) {
            event.preventDefault();

            const billId = document.getElementById('editBillId').value;
            const updates = {
                name: document.getElementById('editBillName').value,
                amount_cad: parseFloat(document.getElementById('editBillAmountCAD').value),
                amount_usd: parseFloat(document.getElementById('editBillAmountUSD').value),
                due_date: document.getElementById('editBillDueDate').value || null
            };

            try {
                if (isDemoMode) {
                    await demo_updateBill(billId, updates);
                    
                    // Also update paid status if changed
                    const paid = document.getElementById('editBillPaid').checked;
                    const originalBill = bills.find(b => b.id == billId);
                    if (originalBill && originalBill.paid !== paid) {
                        await demo_markBillPaid(billId, paid);
                    }
                    
                    renderBills();
                    recalculateTarget();
                    updateStats();
                } else {
                    await window.api.updateBill(billId, updates);

                    // Also update paid status if changed
                    const paid = document.getElementById('editBillPaid').checked;
                    const originalBill = bills.find(b => b.id == billId);
                    if (originalBill && originalBill.paid !== paid) {
                        await window.api.markBillPaid(billId, paid);
                    }

                    await loadDashboardData();
                }

                closeEditBillModal();
                alert('✅ Bill updated successfully!');
            } catch (error) {
                alert('❌ Error updating bill: ' + error.message);
            }
        }

        function editBill(id) {
            const bill = bills.find(b => b.id === id);
            if (!bill) return;

            showEditBillModal(bill);
        }

        // Toggle Bill Paid
        async function toggleBillPaid(id, paid) {
            try {
                await window.api.markBillPaid(id, paid);
                await loadBills();
            } catch (error) {
                alert('Error updating bill: ' + error.message);
            }
        }

        // Delete Bill
        async function deleteBill(id) {
            if (!confirm('Delete this bill?')) return;

            try {
                await window.api.deleteBill(id);
                await loadDashboardData();
            } catch (error) {
                alert('Error deleting bill: ' + error.message);
            }
        }

        // Export Data
        async function exportData() {
            try {
                const data = await window.api.exportData();
                const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = url;
                a.download = `survival-dashboard-export-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.json`;
                document.body.appendChild(a);
                a.click();
                document.body.removeChild(a);
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                closeBurgerMenu();
            } catch (error) {
                alert('Error exporting data: ' + error.message);
            }
        }

        // Import Data
        function importData() {
            document.getElementById('importFile').click();
            closeBurgerMenu();
        }

        async function handleImport(event) {
            const file = event.target.files[0];
            if (!file) return;

            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = async function (e) {
                try {
                    const data = JSON.parse(e.target.result);

                    // Validate data format
                    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') {
                        alert('❌ Invalid data format');
                        return;
                    }

                    // Check if user wants to add to existing data
                    const hasExistingData = sessions.length > 0 || bills.length > 0;
                    if (hasExistingData) {
                        const confirmOverwrite = confirm(
                            `You have ${sessions.length} sessions and ${bills.length} bills in your account.\n\n` +
                            'Import will ADD the data from the file to your existing data.\n\n' +
                            'Continue with import?'
                        );
                        if (!confirmOverwrite) return;
                    }

                    let importedSessions = 0;
                    let importedBills = 0;
                    let skippedSessions = 0;
                    let skippedBills = 0;

                    // Import Sessions
                    if (data.sessions && Array.isArray(data.sessions)) {
                        for (const session of data.sessions) {
                            try {
                                // Map old format to new API format
                                const sessionData = {
                                    time_display: session.time || session.time_display || 'Imported',
                                    timestamp: session.timestamp || new Date(session.date || Date.now()).toISOString(),
                                    date: session.date ? new Date(session.date).toISOString().split('T')[0] : new Date(session.timestamp).toISOString().split('T')[0],
                                    hours: parseFloat(session.hours || 0),
                                    rate: parseFloat(session.rate || 0),
                                    earnings: parseFloat(session.earnings || 0),
                                    note: session.note || '',
                                    is_leisure: session.isLeisure || session.is_leisure || false,
                                    opportunity_cost: parseFloat(session.opportunityCost || session.opportunity_cost || 0),
                                    is_manual: true
                                };

                                await window.api.createSession(sessionData);
                                importedSessions++;
                            } catch (error) {
                                console.error('Error importing session:', error);
                                skippedSessions++;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Import Bills (if present in file)
                    if (data.bills && Array.isArray(data.bills)) {
                        for (const bill of data.bills) {
                            try {
                                // Map bill data
                                const billData = {
                                    name: bill.name || 'Imported Bill',
                                    amount_cad: parseFloat(bill.amount || bill.amount_cad || 0),
                                    amount_usd: parseFloat(bill.amountUSD || bill.amount_usd || (bill.amount / 1.4) || 0),
                                    due_date: bill.dueDate || bill.due_date || null
                                };

                                await window.api.createBill(billData);
                                importedBills++;
                            } catch (error) {
                                console.error('Error importing bill:', error);
                                skippedBills++;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Show results
                    let message = '✅ Import Complete!\n\n';
                    if (importedSessions > 0) message += `📝 Imported ${importedSessions} session(s)\n`;
                    if (importedBills > 0) message += `💸 Imported ${importedBills} bill(s)\n`;
                    if (skippedSessions > 0) message += `⚠️ Skipped ${skippedSessions} session(s) due to errors\n`;
                    if (skippedBills > 0) message += `⚠️ Skipped ${skippedBills} bill(s) due to errors\n`;

                    if (importedSessions === 0 && importedBills === 0) {
                        message = '⚠️ No data was imported. The file may not contain sessions or bills.';
                    }

                    alert(message);

                    // Reload dashboard to show imported data
                    await loadDashboardData();
                    closeBurgerMenu();

                } catch (err) {
                    console.error('Import error:', err);
                    alert('❌ Error importing data: ' + err.message);
                }
            };
            reader.readAsText(file);
            event.target.value = '';
        }

        // Export Bills CSV
        async function exportBillsCSV() {
            closeBurgerMenu();
            try {
                const blob = await window.api.exportBillsCSV();
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = url;
                a.download = `bills-export-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`;
                document.body.appendChild(a);
                a.click();
                document.body.removeChild(a);
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                alert('✅ Bills exported as CSV successfully!');
            } catch (error) {
                alert('❌ Error exporting bills CSV: ' + error.message);
            }
        }

        // Import Bills CSV
        function importBillsCSV() {
            document.getElementById('importBillsCsvFile').click();
            closeBurgerMenu();
        }

        async function handleBillsCsvImport(event) {
            const file = event.target.files[0];
            if (!file) return;

            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = async function (e) {
                try {
                    const csvData = e.target.result;

                    // Check if user wants to add to existing data
                    const hasExistingBills = bills.length > 0;
                    if (hasExistingBills) {
                        const confirmImport = confirm(
                            `You have ${bills.length} bills in your account.\n\n` +
                            'Import will ADD the bills from the CSV file to your existing bills.\n\n' +
                            'Continue with import?'
                        );
                        if (!confirmImport) return;
                    }

                    const result = await window.api.importBillsCSV(csvData);

                    let message = '✅ CSV Import Complete!\n\n';
                    message += `📝 Imported ${result.imported} bill(s)\n`;
                    if (result.errors > 0) {
                        message += `⚠️ ${result.errors} error(s) encountered\n`;
                        if (result.details && result.details.length > 0) {
                            message += '\nErrors:\n';
                            result.details.forEach(err => {
                                message += `Line ${err.line}: ${err.error}\n`;
                            });
                        }
                    }

                    alert(message);
                    await loadDashboardData();

                } catch (err) {
                    console.error('CSV import error:', err);
                    alert('❌ Error importing CSV: ' + err.message);
                }
            };
            reader.readAsText(file);
            event.target.value = '';
        }

        // Logout
        function handleLogout() {
            if (confirm('Are you sure you want to logout?')) {
                localStorage.removeItem('authToken');
                window.location.href = '/login.html';
            }
        }

        // Close modals on outside click
        document.getElementById('addSessionModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id === 'addSessionModal') closeAddSessionModal();
        });

        document.getElementById('addBillModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id === 'addBillModal') closeAddBillModal();
        });

        document.getElementById('editSessionModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id === 'editSessionModal') closeEditSessionModal();
        });

        document.getElementById('editBillModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id === 'editBillModal') closeEditBillModal();
        });

        document.getElementById('sprintSettingsModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id === 'sprintSettingsModal') closeSprintSettingsModal();
        });

        // ===== AUTH MODAL HANDLERS =====

        function showLoginModal() {
            document.getElementById('loginModal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function closeLoginModal() {
            document.getElementById('loginModal').classList.remove('active');
            document.getElementById('loginErrorMessage').style.display = 'none';
        }

        function showRegisterModal() {
            document.getElementById('registerModal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function closeRegisterModal() {
            document.getElementById('registerModal').classList.remove('active');
            document.getElementById('registerErrorMessage').style.display = 'none';
        }

        function switchToRegister() {
            closeLoginModal();
            showRegisterModal();
        }

        function switchToLogin() {
            closeRegisterModal();
            showLoginModal();
        }

        async function handleLoginSubmit(event) {
            event.preventDefault();

            const email = document.getElementById('modalLoginEmail').value;
            const password = document.getElementById('modalLoginPassword').value;

            try {
                const response = await window.api.login(email, password);
                localStorage.setItem('authToken', response.token);
                
                // Clear demo data
                sessionStorage.removeItem('demoSessions');
                sessionStorage.removeItem('demoBills');
                sessionStorage.removeItem('demoSettings');
                isDemoMode = false;

                // Remove demo banner
                const banner = document.getElementById('demoBanner');
                if (banner) banner.remove();

                // Close modal
                closeLoginModal();

                // Load user data
                currentUser = await window.api.getProfile();
                await loadDashboardData();
                showUserMenu();

                console.log('✅ Logged in successfully');
            } catch (error) {
                const errorDiv = document.getElementById('loginErrorMessage');
                errorDiv.textContent = error.message || 'Login failed. Please check your credentials.';
                errorDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        }

        async function handleRegisterSubmit(event) {
            event.preventDefault();

            const name = document.getElementById('modalRegisterName').value;
            const email = document.getElementById('modalRegisterEmail').value;
            const password = document.getElementById('modalRegisterPassword').value;

            try {
                const response = await window.api.register(name, email, password);
                localStorage.setItem('authToken', response.token);
                
                // Clear demo data
                sessionStorage.removeItem('demoSessions');
                sessionStorage.removeItem('demoBills');
                sessionStorage.removeItem('demoSettings');
                isDemoMode = false;

                // Remove demo banner
                const banner = document.getElementById('demoBanner');
                if (banner) banner.remove();

                // Close modal
                closeRegisterModal();

                // Load user data
                currentUser = await window.api.getProfile();
                await loadDashboardData();
                showUserMenu();

                console.log('✅ Registered and logged in successfully');
            } catch (error) {
                const errorDiv = document.getElementById('registerErrorMessage');
                errorDiv.textContent = error.message || 'Registration failed. Please try again.';
                errorDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        }

        // ESC key to close (including auth modals)
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                closeBurgerMenu();
                closeAddSessionModal();
                closeAddBillModal();
                closeEditSessionModal();
                closeEditBillModal();
                closeSprintSettingsModal();
                closeLoginModal();
                closeRegisterModal();
            }
        });
    </script>
</body>

</html>

        /* Bills Conveyor */
        .bills-track {

        }

        .bill-item {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2a0a0a 0%, #1a1a1a 100%);
            border-left: 5px solid #ff3333;
            padding: 15px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            animation: slideIn 0.5s ease-out;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .bill-item::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 0;
            height: 100%;
            width: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 51, 51, 0.1), transparent);
            animation: shimmer 3s infinite;
        }

        .bill-item.urgent {
            border-left-color: #ff0000;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3a0000 0%, #2a0000 100%);
            animation: pulse 2s infinite, slideIn 0.5s ease-out;
        }

        .bill-item.warning {
            border-left-color: #ffaa00;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2a1a00 0%, #1a1a1a 100%);
        }

        .bill-item.paid {
            border-left-color: #00ff88;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a2a1a 0%, #1a1a1a 100%);
            opacity: 0.6;
        }

        @keyframes slideIn {
            from {
                transform: translateX(-20px);
                opacity: 0;
            }

            to {
                transform: translateX(0);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        @keyframes pulse {

            0%,
            100% {
                box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.7);
            }

            50% {
                box-shadow: 0 0 20px 5px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0);
            }
        }

        @keyframes shimmer {
            0% {
                width: 0;
                left: 0;
            }

            50% {
                width: 100%;
                left: 0;
            }

            100% {
                width: 0;
                left: 100%;
            }
        }

        .bill-info {
            flex: 1;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .bill-name {
            font-size: 1.1em;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
        }

        .bill-due {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #999;
        }

        .bill-due.urgent {
            color: #ff3333;
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .bill-amount {
            font-size: 1.5em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #ff3333;
            text-align: right;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            margin: 0 15px;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .bill-amount.paid {
            color: #00ff88;
            text-decoration: line-through;
        }

        .bill-amount-usd {
            font-size: 0.6em;
            color: #999;
            display: block;
        }

        .bills-total {
            margin-top: 15px;
            padding: 15px;
            background: #2a0a0a;
            border-radius: 8px;
            text-align: center;
            border: 2px solid #ff3333;
        }

        .bills-total-label {
            font-size: 1em;
            color: #999;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .bills-total-amount {
            font-size: 2.5em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #ff3333;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        /* Modal */
        .modal {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
            z-index: 2000;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        .modal.show {
            display: flex;
        }

        .modal-content {
            background: #1a1a1a;
            border: 2px solid #333;
            border-radius: 15px;
            padding: 30px;
            max-width: 500px;
            width: 100%;
            max-height: 90vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
            animation: modalSlideIn 0.3s ease-out;
        }

        @keyframes modalSlideIn {
            from {
                transform: translateY(-50px);
                opacity: 0;
            }

            to {
                transform: translateY(0);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        .modal-header {
            font-size: 1.5em;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            color: #00ff88;
        }

        .form-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        .form-row.full {
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }

        .modal-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .btn-modal-primary {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 12px;
            background: #00ff88;
            color: #000;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-modal-primary:hover {
            background: #00cc66;
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .btn-modal-secondary {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 12px;
            background: #444;
            color: #fff;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-modal-secondary:hover {
            background: #555;
        }

        /* Empty States */
        .empty-state {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 40px 20px;
            color: #666;
        }

        .empty-state-icon {
            font-size: 3em;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        /* Date Group Headers */
        .date-group-header {
            background: #2a2a2a;
            padding: 10px 15px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            margin: 20px 0 10px 0;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #00ff88;
        }

        .date-group-stats {
            color: #999;
        }

        /* Loading State */
        .loading {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 40px;
            color: #666;
        }

        .spinner {
            border: 4px solid #2a2a2a;
            border-top: 4px solid #00ff88;
            border-radius: 50%;
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
            margin: 20px auto;
        }

        @keyframes spin {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0deg);
            }

            100% {
                transform: rotate(360deg);
            }
        }

        /* Responsive */
        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .hero-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .stats-row {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .main-content {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .stats-grid.four-col {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .countdown-timer {
                font-size: 2.5em;
            }

            .big-number {
                font-size: 2em;
            }

            .header h1 {
                font-size: 1.8em;
            }

            .form-row {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
        }

        /* Scrollbar Styling */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: #1a1a1a;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #444;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: #555;
        }

        /* Badge */
        .badge {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 2px 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: 0.75em;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-left: 8px;
        }

        .badge.manual {
            background: #444;
            color: #999;
        }

        .badge.leisure {
            background: #ff3333;
            color: #fff;
        }

        /* ===== DEMO MODE STYLES ===== */
        
        .demo-banner {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            z-index: 10000;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1 0%, #8b5cf6 100%);
            color: white;
            padding: 12px 20px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3);
            animation: slideDown 0.3s ease-out;
        }

        @keyframes slideDown {
            from {
                transform: translateY(-100%);
                opacity: 0;
            }
            to {
                transform: translateY(0);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        .demo-banner-content {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 15px;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .demo-banner-icon {
            font-size: 1.5em;
        }

        .demo-banner-text {
            font-weight: 500;
            font-size: 0.95em;
        }

        .demo-banner-btn {
            background: white;
            color: #6366f1;
            border: none;
            padding: 8px 20px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            font-size: 0.9em;
        }

        .demo-banner-btn:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
        }

        .demo-banner-dismiss {
            background: transparent;
            color: white;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
            padding: 4px 12px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            font-size: 0.9em;
            margin-left: auto;
        }

        .demo-banner-dismiss:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        }

        /* Auth Buttons (Top Right) */
        .auth-buttons {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .btn-auth {
            padding: 8px 20px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            font-size: 0.9em;
            border: none;
        }

        .btn-login {
            background: transparent;
            color: #fff;
            border: 2px solid #fff;
        }

        .btn-login:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .btn-register {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00ff88 0%, #00cc66 100%);
            color: #000;
        }

        .btn-register:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.4);
        }

        /* Auth Modals */
        .auth-modal {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            z-index: 10001;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            animation: fadeIn 0.2s ease-out;
        }

        .auth-modal.active {
            display: flex;
        }

        .auth-modal-content {
            background: #1a1a1a;
            border: 2px solid #ff3333;
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 40px;
            width: 90%;
            max-width: 450px;
            position: relative;
            animation: slideUp 0.3s ease-out;
        }

        @keyframes slideUp {
            from {
                transform: translateY(30px);
                opacity: 0;
            }
            to {
                transform: translateY(0);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        .auth-modal-close {
            position: absolute;
            top: 15px;
            right: 20px;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: #999;
            font-size: 1.5em;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 5px;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .auth-modal-close:hover {
            color: #fff;
        }

        /* Responsive Demo Banner */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .demo-banner-content {
                flex-direction: column;
                gap: 10px;
            }

            .demo-banner-text {
                font-size: 0.85em;
                text-align: center;
            }

            .demo-banner-dismiss {
                margin-left: 0;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

<body>
    <div class="container">
        <!-- Header with Burger Menu -->
        <div class="header">
            <div class="header-title">
                <h1>🔥 SURVIVAL MODE 🔥</h1>
                <div class="header-subtitle">Last Day to Work: October 24, 2025</div>
            </div>
            <button class="burger-btn" onclick="toggleBurgerMenu()">☰</button>
        </div>

        <!-- Burger Menu Overlay -->
        <div class="burger-overlay" id="burgerOverlay" onclick="closeBurgerMenu()"></div>

        <!-- Burger Menu -->
        <div class="burger-menu" id="burgerMenu">
            <div class="burger-menu-header">
                <div class="burger-menu-title">Menu</div>
                <button class="burger-close" onclick="closeBurgerMenu()">✕</button>
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="exportData()">
                📥 Export Data (JSON)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="importData()">
                📤 Import Data (JSON)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="exportBillsCSV()">
                📋 Export Bills (CSV)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="importBillsCSV()">
                📂 Import Bills (CSV)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="showSprintSettingsModal()">
                ⚙️ Sprint Settings
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item logout" onclick="handleLogout()">
                🚪 Logout
            </div>
        </div>
        <input type="file" id="importFile" accept=".json" style="display: none;" onchange="handleImport(event)">
        <input type="file" id="importBillsCsvFile" accept=".csv" style="display: none;"
            onchange="handleBillsCsvImport(event)">

        <!-- Countdown Banner -->
        <div class="deadline-countdown">
            <div class="countdown-timer" id="countdown">--:--:--</div>
            <div class="countdown-label">Until Oct 24 Work Deadline</div>
        </div>

        <!-- Hero Dashboard Grid -->
        <div class="hero-grid">
            <!-- Today's Goal -->
            <div class="card critical">
                <div class="card-title">💰 TODAY'S GOAL</div>
                <div class="big-number" id="dailyGoal">$0</div>
                <div class="progress-bar">
                    <div class="progress-fill" id="todayProgress" style="width: 0%"></div>
                    <div class="progress-text" id="todayProgressText">$0 / $0</div>
                </div>
                <div id="todayStatus" class="status-message status-behind">
                    Loading...
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Work Timer -->
            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">⏱️ WORK TIMER</div>
                <div class="timer-display" id="timerDisplay">00:00:00</div>
                <div class="timer-controls">
                    <button class="btn btn-start" id="startBtn" onclick="startTimer()">START</button>
                    <button class="btn btn-stop" id="stopBtn" onclick="stopTimer()" style="display:none">STOP</button>
                    <button class="btn btn-reset" id="resetBtn" onclick="resetTimer()">RESET</button>
                </div>
                <div class="input-group">
                    <label>Hourly Rate ($)</label>
                    <input type="number" id="hourlyRate" value="24" min="0" max="100" step="0.5">
                    <div style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #666; margin-top: 5px;">
                        Set to $0 for leisure/break time
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-item" style="margin-top: 15px;">
                    <div class="stat-value" id="currentSessionEarnings">$0.00</div>
                    <div class="stat-label">Current Session</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- 9-Day Sprint -->
            <div class="card warning">
                <div class="card-title">📊 9-DAY SPRINT</div>
                <div class="big-number" id="totalEarned">$0</div>
                <div style="font-size: 0.9em; color: #999;">of $<span id="totalNeeded">0</span> needed</div>
                <div class="progress-bar">
                    <div class="progress-fill" id="sprintProgress" style="width: 0%"></div>
                    <div class="progress-text" id="sprintProgressText">0%</div>
                </div>
                <div class="stats-grid">
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value" id="daysLeft">0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Days Left</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value red" id="remaining">$0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">To Earn</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Stats Row -->
        <div class="stats-row">
            <!-- Quick Stats -->
            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">📈 QUICK STATS</div>
                <div class="stats-grid">
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value" id="todayHours">0.0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Hours Today</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value" id="todayEarnings">$0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Earned Today</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value" id="hoursNeeded">0.0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Hrs/Day Needed</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value" id="totalHoursNeeded">0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Total Hrs Left</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Bills Breakdown -->
            <div class="card critical">
                <div class="card-title">💸 BILLS BREAKDOWN (CAD → USD)</div>
                <div class="stats-grid four-col">
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value red" id="billsTotalCAD">$0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Total CAD</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value yellow" id="billsTotalUSD">$0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Total USD (~1.4)</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value red" id="billsWithTax">$0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">USD + Tax (33%)</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value" id="billsCovered">0%</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Covered</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Main Content: Sessions + Bills Side by Side -->
        <div class="main-content">
            <!-- Session History -->
            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">📝 SESSION HISTORY</div>
                <div class="session-controls">
                    <input type="date" id="viewDate">
                    <button class="btn-small primary" onclick="viewToday()">Today</button>
                    <button class="btn-small secondary" onclick="viewAllDays()">All</button>
                    <button class="btn-small primary" onclick="showAddSessionModal()">➕ Add Manual Entry</button>
                </div>
                <div class="session-history" id="sessionHistory">
                    <div class="loading">
                        <div class="spinner"></div>
                        Loading sessions...
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Bills Conveyor -->
            <div class="card critical">
                <div class="card-title">💸 BILLS CONVEYOR</div>
                <button class="btn-small primary" style="width: 100%; margin-bottom: 15px;"
                    onclick="showAddBillModal()">➕ Add Bill</button>
                <div class="bills-track" id="billsTrack">
                    <div class="loading">
                        <div class="spinner"></div>
                        Loading bills...
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="bills-total">
                    <div class="bills-total-label">TOTAL REMAINING</div>
                    <div class="bills-total-amount" id="billsTotal">$0.00</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Tax Savings Tracker (Bottom of Page) -->
        <div class="card warning" style="max-width: 1400px; margin: 20px auto;">
            <div class="card-title">💰 TAX RESERVE TRACKING</div>
            <div class="stats-grid four-col">
                <div class="stat-item">
                    <div class="stat-value" id="taxEarnings">$0</div>
                    <div class="stat-label">Work Earnings</div>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-item">
                    <div class="stat-value yellow" id="taxReserve">$0</div>
                    <div class="stat-label">Should Save</div>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-item">
                    <div class="stat-value green" id="taxAfter">$0</div>
                    <div class="stat-label">After Taxes</div>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-item">
                    <div class="stat-value" id="taxRate">30%</div>
                    <div class="stat-label">Reserve Rate</div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div style="margin-top: 15px; padding-top: 15px; border-top: 1px solid #333;">
                <label style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; cursor: pointer; color: #999;">
                    <input type="checkbox" id="taxIncludeInitial" onchange="updateStats()" style="width: auto;">
                    <span>Include Initial Balance ($<span id="taxInitialAmount">0</span>) in tax calculation</span>
                </label>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Add Session Modal -->
    <div class="modal" id="addSessionModal">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">➕ Add Work Session</div>
            <form onsubmit="addManualSession(event)">
                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Date</label>
                        <input type="date" id="manualDate" required>
                    </div>
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Rate ($/hr)</label>
                        <input type="number" id="manualRate" min="0" max="100" step="0.5" value="24" required>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Start Time</label>
                        <input type="time" id="manualStartTime" required>
                    </div>
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>End Time</label>
                        <input type="time" id="manualEndTime" required>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Note (optional)</label>
                        <input type="text" id="manualNote" placeholder="What did you work on?">
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-actions">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn-modal-primary">Add Session</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-modal-secondary" onclick="closeAddSessionModal()">Cancel</button>
                </div>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Add Bill Modal -->
    <div class="modal" id="addBillModal">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">💸 Add Bill</div>
            <form onsubmit="addBill(event)">
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Bill Name</label>
                        <input type="text" id="billName" placeholder="e.g., Rent, Utilities" required>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Amount CAD</label>
                        <input type="number" id="billAmountCAD" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="0.00" required
                            onchange="autoCalculateUSD()">
                    </div>
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Amount USD</label>
                        <input type="number" id="billAmountUSD" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="0.00" required>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Due Date (optional)</label>
                        <input type="date" id="billDueDate">
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-actions">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn-modal-primary">Add Bill</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-modal-secondary" onclick="closeAddBillModal()">Cancel</button>
                </div>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Edit Bill Modal -->
    <div class="modal" id="editBillModal">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">✏️ Edit Bill</div>
            <form onsubmit="updateBill(event)">
                <input type="hidden" id="editBillId">
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Bill Name</label>
                        <input type="text" id="editBillName" placeholder="e.g., Rent, Utilities" required>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Amount CAD</label>
                        <input type="number" id="editBillAmountCAD" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="0.00" required
                            onchange="autoCalculateEditBillUSD()">
                    </div>
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Amount USD</label>
                        <input type="number" id="editBillAmountUSD" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="0.00" required>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Due Date (optional)</label>
                        <input type="date" id="editBillDueDate">
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; cursor: pointer;">
                            <input type="checkbox" id="editBillPaid" style="width: auto;">
                            <span>Mark as Paid</span>
                        </label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-actions">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn-modal-primary">Save Changes</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-modal-secondary" onclick="closeEditBillModal()">Cancel</button>
                </div>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Edit Session Modal -->
    <div class="modal" id="editSessionModal">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">✏️ Edit Work Session</div>
            <form onsubmit="updateSession(event)">
                <input type="hidden" id="editSessionId">
                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Date</label>
                        <input type="date" id="editSessionDate" required>
                    </div>
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Start Time</label>
                        <input type="time" id="editSessionTime" required>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Hours Worked</label>
                        <input type="number" id="editSessionHours" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="0.00" required
                            onchange="calculateEditEarnings()">
                    </div>
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Hourly Rate ($)</label>
                        <input type="number" id="editSessionRate" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="0.00" required
                            onchange="calculateEditEarnings()">
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Notes</label>
                        <input type="text" id="editSessionNote" placeholder="What did you work on?">
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; cursor: pointer;">
                            <input type="checkbox" id="editSessionLeisure" style="width: auto;"
                                onchange="calculateEditEarnings()">
                            <span>This is leisure/break time (no earnings)</span>
                        </label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-item"
                    style="margin-top: 15px; padding: 15px; background: #2a2a2a; border-radius: 8px;">
                    <div class="stat-label">Calculated Earnings</div>
                    <div class="stat-value" id="editSessionEarnings">$0.00</div>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-actions">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn-modal-primary">Save Changes</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-modal-secondary" onclick="closeEditSessionModal()">Cancel</button>
                </div>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Sprint Settings Modal -->
    <div class="modal" id="sprintSettingsModal">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">⚙️ Sprint Settings</div>
            <form onsubmit="saveSprintSettings(event)">
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Sprint End Date & Time</label>
                        <input type="datetime-local" id="sprintEndDate" required>
                        <div style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #666; margin-top: 5px;">
                            The deadline for your sprint
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Target Bills Mode</label>
                        <select id="targetBillsMode" onchange="toggleManualTarget()"
                            style="padding: 10px; background: #2a2a2a; color: #fff; border: 2px solid #333; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1em;">
                            <option value="auto_unpaid">Auto - Unpaid Bills Only</option>
                            <option value="auto_all">Auto - All Bills</option>
                            <option value="manual">Manual Target</option>
                        </select>
                        <div style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #666; margin-top: 5px;">
                            How to calculate your sprint target
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row full" id="manualTargetRow" style="display: none;">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Manual Target Amount ($)</label>
                        <input type="number" id="targetBillsManual" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="0.00">
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>💰 Initial Balance (Starting Earnings)</label>
                        <input type="number" id="initialBalance" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="0.00" required>
                        <div style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #666; margin-top: 5px;">
                            Money earned before tracking started
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Currency</label>
                        <select id="initialBalanceCurrency"
                            style="padding: 10px; background: #2a2a2a; color: #fff; border: 2px solid #333; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1em;">
                            <option value="USD">USD ($)</option>
                            <option value="CAD">CAD ($)</option>
                        </select>
                        <div style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #666; margin-top: 5px;">
                            Will auto-convert to USD
                        </div>

                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Default Hourly Rate ($)</label>
                        <input type="number" id="defaultHourlyRate" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="55.00" required>
                    </div>
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Tax Reserve Rate (%)</label>
                        <input type="number" id="taxReserveRate" step="0.01" min="0" max="100" placeholder="30.00"
                            required>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>CAD to USD Exchange Rate</label>
                        <input type="number" id="exchangeRate" step="0.0001" min="0" placeholder="0.7143" required>
                        <div style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #666; margin-top: 5px;">
                            1 CAD = ? USD (e.g., 0.7143 means $1 CAD = $0.71 USD)
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-actions">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn-modal-primary">Save Settings</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-modal-secondary"
                        onclick="closeSprintSettingsModal()">Cancel</button>
                </div>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Login Modal -->
    <div class="auth-modal" id="loginModal">
        <div class="auth-modal-content">
            <button class="auth-modal-close" onclick="closeLoginModal()">×</button>
            <h2 style="color: #ff3333; margin-bottom: 10px; text-align: center;">Login</h2>
            <p style="text-align: center; color: #666; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 14px;">Access your dashboard</p>
            
            <div class="error-message" id="loginErrorMessage" style="display: none;"></div>
            
            <form onsubmit="handleLoginSubmit(event)">
                <div style="margin-bottom: 20px;">
                    <label style="display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; color: #999; font-size: 14px;">Email</label>
                    <input type="email" id="modalLoginEmail" required placeholder="your@email.com" 
                        style="width: 100%; padding: 12px; background: #2a2a2a; color: #fff; border: 2px solid #333; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1em;">
                </div>
                <div style="margin-bottom: 20px;">
                    <label style="display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; color: #999; font-size: 14px;">Password</label>
                    <input type="password" id="modalLoginPassword" required placeholder="••••••••"
                        style="width: 100%; padding: 12px; background: #2a2a2a; color: #fff; border: 2px solid #333; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1em;">
                </div>
                <button type="submit" style="width: 100%; padding: 14px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00ff88 0%, #00cc66 100%); color: #000; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; font-size: 1em;">
                    Login
                </button>
            </form>
            <p style="text-align: center; margin-top: 20px; color: #999; font-size: 14px;">
                Don't have an account? 
                <button onclick="switchToRegister()" style="background: none; border: none; color: #00ff88; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: underline;">Register</button>
