        // Import Data
        function importData() {
            document.getElementById('importFile').click();
            closeBurgerMenu();
        }

        async function handleImport(event) {
            const file = event.target.files[0];
            if (!file) return;

            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = async function (e) {
                try {
                    const data = JSON.parse(e.target.result);

                    // Validate data format
                    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') {
                        alert('❌ Invalid data format');
                        return;
                    }

                    // Check if user wants to add to existing data
                    const hasExistingData = sessions.length > 0 || bills.length > 0;
                    if (hasExistingData) {
                        const confirmOverwrite = confirm(
                            `You have ${sessions.length} sessions and ${bills.length} bills in your account.\n\n` +
                            'Import will ADD the data from the file to your existing data.\n\n' +
                            'Continue with import?'
                        );
                        if (!confirmOverwrite) return;
                    }

                    let importedSessions = 0;
                    let importedBills = 0;
                    let skippedSessions = 0;
                    let skippedBills = 0;

                    // Import Sessions
                    if (data.sessions && Array.isArray(data.sessions)) {
                        for (const session of data.sessions) {
                            try {
                                // Map old format to new API format
                                const sessionData = {
                                    time_display: session.time || session.time_display || 'Imported',
                                    timestamp: session.timestamp || new Date(session.date || Date.now()).toISOString(),
                                    date: session.date ? new Date(session.date).toISOString().split('T')[0] : new Date(session.timestamp).toISOString().split('T')[0],
                                    hours: parseFloat(session.hours || 0),
                                    rate: parseFloat(session.rate || 0),
                                    earnings: parseFloat(session.earnings || 0),
                                    note: session.note || '',
                                    is_leisure: session.isLeisure || session.is_leisure || false,
                                    opportunity_cost: parseFloat(session.opportunityCost || session.opportunity_cost || 0),
                                    is_manual: true
                                };

                                await window.api.createSession(sessionData);
                                importedSessions++;
                            } catch (error) {
                                console.error('Error importing session:', error);
                                skippedSessions++;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Import Bills (if present in file)
                    if (data.bills && Array.isArray(data.bills)) {
                        for (const bill of data.bills) {
                            try {
                                // Map bill data
                                const billData = {
                                    name: bill.name || 'Imported Bill',
                                    amount_cad: parseFloat(bill.amount || bill.amount_cad || 0),
                                    amount_usd: parseFloat(bill.amountUSD || bill.amount_usd || (bill.amount / 1.4) || 0),
                                    due_date: bill.dueDate || bill.due_date || null
                                };

                                await window.api.createBill(billData);
                                importedBills++;
                            } catch (error) {
                                console.error('Error importing bill:', error);
                                skippedBills++;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Show results
                    let message = '✅ Import Complete!\n\n';
                    if (importedSessions > 0) message += `📝 Imported ${importedSessions} session(s)\n`;
                    if (importedBills > 0) message += `💸 Imported ${importedBills} bill(s)\n`;
                    if (skippedSessions > 0) message += `⚠️ Skipped ${skippedSessions} session(s) due to errors\n`;
                    if (skippedBills > 0) message += `⚠️ Skipped ${skippedBills} bill(s) due to errors\n`;

                    if (importedSessions === 0 && importedBills === 0) {
                        message = '⚠️ No data was imported. The file may not contain sessions or bills.';
                    }

                    alert(message);

                    // Reload dashboard to show imported data
                    await loadDashboardData();
                    closeBurgerMenu();

                } catch (err) {
                    console.error('Import error:', err);
                    alert('❌ Error importing data: ' + err.message);
                }
            };
            reader.readAsText(file);
            event.target.value = '';
        }

        // Export Bills CSV
        async function exportBillsCSV() {
            closeBurgerMenu();
            try {
                const blob = await window.api.exportBillsCSV();
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = url;
                a.download = `bills-export-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`;
                document.body.appendChild(a);
                a.click();
                document.body.removeChild(a);
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                alert('✅ Bills exported as CSV successfully!');
            } catch (error) {
                alert('❌ Error exporting bills CSV: ' + error.message);
            }
        }

        // Import Bills CSV
        function importBillsCSV() {
            document.getElementById('importBillsCsvFile').click();
            closeBurgerMenu();
        }

        async function handleBillsCsvImport(event) {
            const file = event.target.files[0];
            if (!file) return;

            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = async function (e) {
                try {
                    const csvData = e.target.result;

                    // Check if user wants to add to existing data
                    const hasExistingBills = bills.length > 0;
                    if (hasExistingBills) {
                        const confirmImport = confirm(
                            `You have ${bills.length} bills in your account.\n\n` +
                            'Import will ADD the bills from the CSV file to your existing bills.\n\n' +
                            'Continue with import?'
                        );
                        if (!confirmImport) return;
                    }

                    const result = await window.api.importBillsCSV(csvData);

                    let message = '✅ CSV Import Complete!\n\n';
                    message += `📝 Imported ${result.imported} bill(s)\n`;
                    if (result.errors > 0) {
                        message += `⚠️ ${result.errors} error(s) encountered\n`;
                        if (result.details && result.details.length > 0) {
                            message += '\nErrors:\n';
                            result.details.forEach(err => {
                                message += `Line ${err.line}: ${err.error}\n`;
                            });
                        }
                    }

                    alert(message);
                    await loadDashboardData();

                } catch (err) {
                    console.error('CSV import error:', err);
                    alert('❌ Error importing CSV: ' + err.message);
                }
            };
            reader.readAsText(file);
            event.target.value = '';
        }

        // Logout
        function handleLogout() {
            if (confirm('Are you sure you want to logout?')) {
                localStorage.removeItem('authToken');
                window.location.href = '/login.html';
            }
        }

        // Close modals on outside click
        document.getElementById('addSessionModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id === 'addSessionModal') closeAddSessionModal();
        });

        document.getElementById('addBillModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id === 'addBillModal') closeAddBillModal();
        });

        document.getElementById('editSessionModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id === 'editSessionModal') closeEditSessionModal();
        });

        document.getElementById('editBillModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id === 'editBillModal') closeEditBillModal();
        });

        document.getElementById('sprintSettingsModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id === 'sprintSettingsModal') closeSprintSettingsModal();
        });

        // ===== AUTH MODAL HANDLERS =====

        function showLoginModal() {
            document.getElementById('loginModal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function closeLoginModal() {
            document.getElementById('loginModal').classList.remove('active');
            document.getElementById('loginErrorMessage').style.display = 'none';
        }

        function showRegisterModal() {
            document.getElementById('registerModal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function closeRegisterModal() {
            document.getElementById('registerModal').classList.remove('active');
            document.getElementById('registerErrorMessage').style.display = 'none';
        }

        function switchToRegister() {
            closeLoginModal();
            showRegisterModal();
        }

        function switchToLogin() {
            closeRegisterModal();
            showLoginModal();
        }

        async function handleLoginSubmit(event) {
            event.preventDefault();

            const email = document.getElementById('modalLoginEmail').value;
            const password = document.getElementById('modalLoginPassword').value;

            try {
                const response = await window.api.login(email, password);
                localStorage.setItem('authToken', response.token);
                
                // Clear demo data
                sessionStorage.removeItem('demoSessions');
                sessionStorage.removeItem('demoBills');
                sessionStorage.removeItem('demoSettings');
                isDemoMode = false;

                // Remove demo banner
                const banner = document.getElementById('demoBanner');
                if (banner) banner.remove();

                // Close modal
                closeLoginModal();

                // Load user data
                currentUser = await window.api.getProfile();
                await loadDashboardData();
                showUserMenu();

                console.log('✅ Logged in successfully');
            } catch (error) {
                const errorDiv = document.getElementById('loginErrorMessage');
                errorDiv.textContent = error.message || 'Login failed. Please check your credentials.';
                errorDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        }

        async function handleRegisterSubmit(event) {
            event.preventDefault();

            const name = document.getElementById('modalRegisterName').value;
            const email = document.getElementById('modalRegisterEmail').value;
            const password = document.getElementById('modalRegisterPassword').value;

            try {
                const response = await window.api.register(name, email, password);
                localStorage.setItem('authToken', response.token);
                
                // Clear demo data
                sessionStorage.removeItem('demoSessions');
                sessionStorage.removeItem('demoBills');
                sessionStorage.removeItem('demoSettings');
                isDemoMode = false;

                // Remove demo banner
                const banner = document.getElementById('demoBanner');
                if (banner) banner.remove();

                // Close modal
                closeRegisterModal();

                // Load user data
                currentUser = await window.api.getProfile();
                await loadDashboardData();
                showUserMenu();

                console.log('✅ Registered and logged in successfully');
            } catch (error) {
                const errorDiv = document.getElementById('registerErrorMessage');
                errorDiv.textContent = error.message || 'Registration failed. Please try again.';
                errorDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        }

        // ESC key to close (including auth modals)
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                closeBurgerMenu();
                closeAddSessionModal();
                closeAddBillModal();
                closeEditSessionModal();
                closeEditBillModal();
                closeSprintSettingsModal();
                closeLoginModal();
                closeRegisterModal();
            }
        });
    </script>
</body>

</html>
```

            margin-bottom: 5px;

            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .burger-btn:hover {
            border-color: #ff3333;
            background: #2a2a2a;

        /* Burger Menu */
        .burger-menu {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            right: -300px;
            width: 280px;
            height: 100vh;
            background: #1a1a1a;
            border-left: 2px solid #ff3333;
            z-index: 1001;
            padding: 20px;
            transition: right 0.3s ease;
        }

        .burger-menu.open {
            right: 0;
        }

        .burger-overlay {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
            z-index: 1000;
            display: none;
        }

        .burger-overlay.show {
            display: block;
        }

        .burger-menu-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
            padding-bottom: 15px;
            border-bottom: 2px solid #333;
        }

        .burger-menu-title {
            font-size: 1.2em;
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .burger-close {
            background: none;
            border: none;
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 1.5em;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 5px;
        }

        .burger-menu-item {
            padding: 15px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            background: #2a2a2a;
            border: 2px solid #333;
            border-radius: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            font-size: 1em;
        }

        .burger-menu-item:hover {
            border-color: #00ff88;
            background: #3a3a3a;
        }

        .burger-menu-item.logout {
            border-color: #ff3333;
            color: #ff3333;
        }

        .burger-menu-item.logout:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 51, 51, 0.1);
        }

        /* Countdown Banner */
        .deadline-countdown {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a1a 0%, #2a0a0a 100%);
            border: 3px solid #ff3333;
            border-radius: 15px;
            padding: 20px;
            margin: 20px 0;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .countdown-timer {
            font-size: 4em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #ff3333;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .countdown-label {
            font-size: 1.2em;
            color: #999;
        }

        /* Hero Dashboard Grid */
        .hero-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 20px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        /* Stats Row */
        .stats-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr;
            gap: 20px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        /* Main Content - Side by Side */
        .main-content {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr;
            gap: 20px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .card {
            background: #1a1a1a;
            border: 2px solid #333;
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        .card.critical {
            border-color: #ff3333;
        }

        .card.warning {
            border-color: #ffaa00;
        }

        .card.success {
            border-color: #00ff88;
        }

        .card-title {
            font-size: 1.3em;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            color: #fff;
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .big-number {
            font-size: 3em;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin: 10px 0;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        /* Progress Bars */
        .progress-bar {
            width: 100%;
            height: 30px;
            background: #2a2a2a;
            border-radius: 15px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin: 12px 0;
            position: relative;
        }

        .progress-fill {
            height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #00ff88 0%, #00cc66 100%);
            transition: width 0.5s ease;
            border-radius: 15px;
        }

        .progress-fill.behind {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff3333 0%, #cc0000 100%);
        }

        .progress-text {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #fff;
            text-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
            font-size: 0.9em;
        }

        /* Timer Controls */
        .timer-display {
            font-size: 3em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #fff;
            text-align: center;
            margin: 20px 0;
            font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .timer-controls {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            margin: 15px 0;
        }

        .btn {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 12px 20px;
            font-size: 1em;
            font-weight: bold;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-start {
            background: #00ff88;
            color: #000;
        }

        .btn-start:hover {
            background: #00cc66;
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .btn-stop {
            background: #ff3333;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .btn-stop:hover {
            background: #cc0000;
        }

        .btn-reset {
            background: #ffaa00;
            color: #000;
        }

        .btn-reset:hover {
            background: #cc8800;
        }

        /* Input Groups */
        .input-group {
            margin: 12px 0;
        }

        .input-group label {
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            color: #999;
            font-size: 0.9em;
        }

        .input-group input {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 10px;
            font-size: 1em;
            background: #2a2a2a;
            border: 2px solid #444;
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .input-group input:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: #00ff88;
        }

        /* Stats Grid */
        .stats-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 12px;
            margin-top: 15px;
        }

        .stats-grid.four-col {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
        }

        .stat-item {
            background: #2a2a2a;
            padding: 15px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .stat-value {
            font-size: 1.8em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #00ff88;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .stat-value.red {
            color: #ff3333;
        }

        .stat-value.yellow {
            color: #ffaa00;
        }

        .stat-label {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #999;
            margin-top: 5px;
        }

        /* Status Messages */
        .status-message {
            padding: 12px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            margin: 12px 0;
            font-weight: bold;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .status-behind {
            background: rgba(255, 51, 51, 0.2);
            border: 2px solid #ff3333;
            color: #ff3333;
        }

        .status-ahead {
            background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.2);
            border: 2px solid #00ff88;
            color: #00ff88;
        }

        /* Session History */
        .session-controls {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .session-controls input[type="date"] {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 150px;
            padding: 8px;
            background: #2a2a2a;
            border: 2px solid #444;
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .btn-small {
            padding: 8px 15px;
            font-size: 0.9em;
            font-weight: bold;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-small.primary {
            background: #00ff88;
            color: #000;
        }

        .btn-small.secondary {
            background: #444;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .btn-small:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .session-history {
            max-height: 500px;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }

        .session-item {
            background: #2a2a2a;
            padding: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            transition: background 0.2s;
        }

        .session-item:hover {
            background: #3a3a3a;
        }

        .session-item.leisure {
            background: rgba(255, 51, 51, 0.05);
            border-left: 3px solid #ff3333;
        }

        .session-info {
            flex: 1;
        }

        .session-time {
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 3px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .session-details {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #999;
        }

        .session-note {
            font-size: 0.85em;
            color: #666;
            margin-top: 5px;
            font-style: italic;
        }

        .session-earnings {
            font-size: 1.3em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #00ff88;
            margin: 0 15px;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .session-earnings.negative {
            color: #ff3333;
        }

        .session-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .action-btn {
            padding: 6px 10px;
            background: #2a2a2a;
            border: 1px solid #444;
            color: #fff;
            border-radius: 5px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 0.9em;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .action-btn:hover {
            background: #3a3a3a;
            border-color: #00ff88;
        }

        .action-btn.delete {
            border-color: #ff3333;
            color: #ff3333;
        }

        .action-btn.delete:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 51, 51, 0.1);
        }

        /* Bills Conveyor */
        .bills-track {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 10px;
            max-height: 400px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        .bill-item {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2a0a0a 0%, #1a1a1a 100%);
            border-left: 5px solid #ff3333;
            padding: 15px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            animation: slideIn 0.5s ease-out;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .bill-item::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 0;
            height: 100%;
            width: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 51, 51, 0.1), transparent);
            animation: shimmer 3s infinite;
        }

        .bill-item.urgent {
            border-left-color: #ff0000;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3a0000 0%, #2a0000 100%);
            animation: pulse 2s infinite, slideIn 0.5s ease-out;
        }

        .bill-item.warning {
            border-left-color: #ffaa00;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2a1a00 0%, #1a1a1a 100%);
        }

        .bill-item.paid {
            border-left-color: #00ff88;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a2a1a 0%, #1a1a1a 100%);
            opacity: 0.6;
        }

        @keyframes slideIn {
            from {
                transform: translateX(-20px);
                opacity: 0;
            }

            to {
                transform: translateX(0);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        @keyframes pulse {

            0%,
            100% {
                box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.7);
            }

            50% {
                box-shadow: 0 0 20px 5px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0);
            }
        }

        @keyframes shimmer {
            0% {
                width: 0;
                left: 0;
            }

            50% {
                width: 100%;
                left: 0;
            }

            100% {
                width: 0;
                left: 100%;
            }
        }

        .bill-info {
            flex: 1;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .bill-name {
            font-size: 1.1em;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
        }

        .bill-due {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #999;
        }

        .bill-due.urgent {
            color: #ff3333;
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .bill-amount {
            font-size: 1.5em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #ff3333;
            text-align: right;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            margin: 0 15px;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .bill-amount.paid {
            color: #00ff88;
            text-decoration: line-through;
        }

        .bill-amount-usd {
            font-size: 0.6em;
            color: #999;
            display: block;
        }

        .bills-total {
            margin-top: 15px;
            padding: 15px;
            background: #2a0a0a;
            border-radius: 8px;
            text-align: center;
            border: 2px solid #ff3333;
        }

        .bills-total-label {
            font-size: 1em;
            color: #999;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .bills-total-amount {
            font-size: 2.5em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #ff3333;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        /* Modal */
        .modal {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
            z-index: 2000;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        .modal.show {
            display: flex;
        }

        .modal-content {
            background: #1a1a1a;
            border: 2px solid #333;
            border-radius: 15px;
            padding: 30px;
            max-width: 500px;
            width: 100%;
            max-height: 90vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
            animation: modalSlideIn 0.3s ease-out;
        }

        @keyframes modalSlideIn {
            from {
                transform: translateY(-50px);
                opacity: 0;
            }

            to {
                transform: translateY(0);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        .modal-header {
            font-size: 1.5em;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            color: #00ff88;
        }

        .form-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        .form-row.full {
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }

        .modal-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .btn-modal-primary {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 12px;
            background: #00ff88;
            color: #000;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-modal-primary:hover {
            background: #00cc66;
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .btn-modal-secondary {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 12px;
            background: #444;
            color: #fff;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-modal-secondary:hover {
            background: #555;
        }

        /* Empty States */
        .empty-state {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 40px 20px;
            color: #666;
        }

        .empty-state-icon {
            font-size: 3em;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        /* Date Group Headers */
        .date-group-header {
            background: #2a2a2a;
            padding: 10px 15px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            margin: 20px 0 10px 0;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #00ff88;
        }

        .date-group-stats {
            color: #999;
        }

        /* Loading State */
        .loading {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 40px;
            color: #666;
        }

        .spinner {
            border: 4px solid #2a2a2a;
            border-top: 4px solid #00ff88;
            border-radius: 50%;
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
            margin: 20px auto;
        }

        @keyframes spin {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0deg);
            }

            100% {
                transform: rotate(360deg);
            }
        }

        /* Responsive */
        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .hero-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .stats-row {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .main-content {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .stats-grid.four-col {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .countdown-timer {
                font-size: 2.5em;
            }

            .big-number {
                font-size: 2em;
            }

            .header h1 {
                font-size: 1.8em;
            }

            .form-row {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
        }

        /* Scrollbar Styling */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: #1a1a1a;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #444;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: #555;
        }

        /* Badge */
        .badge {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 2px 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: 0.75em;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-left: 8px;
        }

        .badge.manual {
            background: #444;
            color: #999;
        }

        .badge.leisure {
            background: #ff3333;
            color: #fff;
        }

        /* ===== DEMO MODE STYLES ===== */

        .demo-banner {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            z-index: 10000;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1 0%, #8b5cf6 100%);
            color: white;
            padding: 12px 20px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3);
            animation: slideDown 0.3s ease-out;
        }

        @keyframes slideDown {
            from {
                transform: translateY(-100%);
                opacity: 0;
            }

            to {
                transform: translateY(0);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        .demo-banner-content {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 15px;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .demo-banner-icon {
            font-size: 1.5em;
        }

        .demo-banner-text {
            font-weight: 500;
            font-size: 0.95em;
        }

        .demo-banner-btn {
            background: white;
            color: #6366f1;
            border: none;
            padding: 8px 20px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            font-size: 0.9em;
        }

        .demo-banner-btn:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
        }

        .demo-banner-dismiss {
            background: transparent;
            color: white;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
            padding: 4px 12px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            font-size: 0.9em;
            margin-left: auto;
        }

        .demo-banner-dismiss:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        }

        /* Auth Buttons (Top Right) */
        .auth-buttons {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .btn-auth {
            padding: 8px 20px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            font-size: 0.9em;
            border: none;
        }

        .btn-login {
            background: transparent;
            color: #fff;
            border: 2px solid #fff;
        }

        .btn-login:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .btn-register {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00ff88 0%, #00cc66 100%);
            color: #000;
        }

        .btn-register:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.4);
        }

        /* Auth Modals */
        .auth-modal {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            z-index: 10001;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            animation: fadeIn 0.2s ease-out;
        }

        .auth-modal.active {
            display: flex;
        }

        .auth-modal-content {
            background: #1a1a1a;
            border: 2px solid #ff3333;
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 40px;
            width: 90%;
            max-width: 450px;
            position: relative;
            animation: slideUp 0.3s ease-out;
        }

        @keyframes slideUp {
            from {
                transform: translateY(30px);
                opacity: 0;
            }

            to {
                transform: translateY(0);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        .auth-modal-close {
            position: absolute;
            top: 15px;
            right: 20px;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: #999;
            font-size: 1.5em;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 5px;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .auth-modal-close:hover {
            color: #fff;
        }

        /* Responsive Demo Banner */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .demo-banner-content {
                flex-direction: column;
                gap: 10px;
            }

            .demo-banner-text {
                font-size: 0.85em;
                text-align: center;
            }

            .demo-banner-dismiss {
                margin-left: 0;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

<body>
    <div class="container">
        <!-- Header with Burger Menu -->
        <div class="header">
            <div class="header-title">
                <h1>🔥 SURVIVAL MODE 🔥</h1>
                <div class="header-subtitle">Last Day to Work: October 24, 2025</div>
            </div>
            <button class="burger-btn" onclick="toggleBurgerMenu()">☰</button>
        </div>

        <!-- Burger Menu Overlay -->
        <div class="burger-overlay" id="burgerOverlay" onclick="closeBurgerMenu()"></div>

        <!-- Burger Menu -->
        <div class="burger-menu" id="burgerMenu">
            <div class="burger-menu-header">
                <div class="burger-menu-title">Menu</div>
                <button class="burger-close" onclick="closeBurgerMenu()">✕</button>
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="exportData()">
                📥 Export Data (JSON)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="importData()">
                📤 Import Data (JSON)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="exportBillsCSV()">
                📋 Export Bills (CSV)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="importBillsCSV()">
                📂 Import Bills (CSV)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="showSprintSettingsModal()">
                ⚙️ Sprint Settings
            </div>
