        // Edit Bill
        function showEditBillModal(bill) {
            document.getElementById('editBillId').value = bill.id;
            document.getElementById('editBillName').value = bill.name;
            document.getElementById('editBillAmountCAD').value = bill.amount_cad;
            document.getElementById('editBillAmountUSD').value = bill.amount_usd;
            document.getElementById('editBillDueDate').value = bill.due_date || '';
            document.getElementById('editBillPaid').checked = bill.paid || false;

            document.getElementById('editBillModal').classList.add('show');
        }

        function closeEditBillModal() {
            document.getElementById('editBillModal').classList.remove('show');
        }

        function autoCalculateEditBillUSD() {
            const cadInput = document.getElementById('editBillAmountCAD');
            const usdInput = document.getElementById('editBillAmountUSD');
            const exchangeRate = userSettings ? userSettings.exchange_rate_cad_to_usd : 0.7143;

            if (cadInput && usdInput && cadInput.value) {
                const cad = parseFloat(cadInput.value);
                const usd = (cad * exchangeRate).toFixed(2);
                usdInput.value = usd;
            }
        }

        async function updateBill(event) {
            event.preventDefault();

            const billId = document.getElementById('editBillId').value;
            const updates = {
                name: document.getElementById('editBillName').value,
                amount_cad: parseFloat(document.getElementById('editBillAmountCAD').value),
                amount_usd: parseFloat(document.getElementById('editBillAmountUSD').value),
                due_date: document.getElementById('editBillDueDate').value || null
            };

            try {
                if (isDemoMode) {
                    await demo_updateBill(billId, updates);

                    // Also update paid status if changed
                    const paid = document.getElementById('editBillPaid').checked;
                    const originalBill = bills.find(b => b.id == billId);
                    if (originalBill && originalBill.paid !== paid) {
                        await demo_markBillPaid(billId, paid);
                    }

                    renderBills();
                    recalculateTarget();
                    updateStats();
                } else {
                    await window.api.updateBill(billId, updates);

                    // Also update paid status if changed
                    const paid = document.getElementById('editBillPaid').checked;
                    const originalBill = bills.find(b => b.id == billId);
                    if (originalBill && originalBill.paid !== paid) {
                        await window.api.markBillPaid(billId, paid);
                    }

                    await loadDashboardData();
                }

                closeEditBillModal();
                alert('✅ Bill updated successfully!');
            } catch (error) {
                alert('❌ Error updating bill: ' + error.message);
            }
        }

        function editBill(id) {

            if (!bill) return;

        // Export Data
        async function exportData() {
            try {
                const data = await window.api.exportData();
                const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = url;
                a.download = `survival-dashboard-export-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.json`;
                document.body.appendChild(a);
                a.click();
                document.body.removeChild(a);
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                closeBurgerMenu();
            } catch (error) {
                alert('Error exporting data: ' + error.message);
            }
        }

        // Import Data
        function importData() {
            document.getElementById('importFile').click();
            closeBurgerMenu();
        }

        async function handleImport(event) {
            const file = event.target.files[0];
            if (!file) return;

            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = async function (e) {
                try {
                    const data = JSON.parse(e.target.result);

                    // Validate data format
                    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') {
                        alert('❌ Invalid data format');
                        return;
                    }

                    // Check if user wants to add to existing data
                    const hasExistingData = sessions.length > 0 || bills.length > 0;
                    if (hasExistingData) {
                        const confirmOverwrite = confirm(
                            `You have ${sessions.length} sessions and ${bills.length} bills in your account.\n\n` +
                            'Import will ADD the data from the file to your existing data.\n\n' +
                            'Continue with import?'
                        );
                        if (!confirmOverwrite) return;
                    }

                    let importedSessions = 0;
                    let importedBills = 0;
                    let skippedSessions = 0;
                    let skippedBills = 0;

                    // Import Sessions
                    if (data.sessions && Array.isArray(data.sessions)) {
                        for (const session of data.sessions) {
                            try {
                                // Map old format to new API format
                                const sessionData = {
                                    time_display: session.time || session.time_display || 'Imported',
                                    timestamp: session.timestamp || new Date(session.date || Date.now()).toISOString(),
                                    date: session.date ? new Date(session.date).toISOString().split('T')[0] : new Date(session.timestamp).toISOString().split('T')[0],
                                    hours: parseFloat(session.hours || 0),
                                    rate: parseFloat(session.rate || 0),
                                    earnings: parseFloat(session.earnings || 0),
                                    note: session.note || '',
                                    is_leisure: session.isLeisure || session.is_leisure || false,
                                    opportunity_cost: parseFloat(session.opportunityCost || session.opportunity_cost || 0),
                                    is_manual: true
                                };

                                await window.api.createSession(sessionData);
                                importedSessions++;
                            } catch (error) {
                                console.error('Error importing session:', error);
                                skippedSessions++;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Import Bills (if present in file)
                    if (data.bills && Array.isArray(data.bills)) {
                        for (const bill of data.bills) {
                            try {
                                // Map bill data
                                const billData = {
                                    name: bill.name || 'Imported Bill',
                                    amount_cad: parseFloat(bill.amount || bill.amount_cad || 0),
                                    amount_usd: parseFloat(bill.amountUSD || bill.amount_usd || (bill.amount / 1.4) || 0),
                                    due_date: bill.dueDate || bill.due_date || null
                                };

                                await window.api.createBill(billData);
                                importedBills++;
                            } catch (error) {
                                console.error('Error importing bill:', error);
                                skippedBills++;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Show results
                    let message = '✅ Import Complete!\n\n';
                    if (importedSessions > 0) message += `📝 Imported ${importedSessions} session(s)\n`;
                    if (importedBills > 0) message += `💸 Imported ${importedBills} bill(s)\n`;
                    if (skippedSessions > 0) message += `⚠️ Skipped ${skippedSessions} session(s) due to errors\n`;
                    if (skippedBills > 0) message += `⚠️ Skipped ${skippedBills} bill(s) due to errors\n`;

                    if (importedSessions === 0 && importedBills === 0) {
                        message = '⚠️ No data was imported. The file may not contain sessions or bills.';
                    }

                    alert(message);

                    // Reload dashboard to show imported data
                    await loadDashboardData();
                    closeBurgerMenu();

                } catch (err) {
                    console.error('Import error:', err);
                    alert('❌ Error importing data: ' + err.message);
                }
            };
            reader.readAsText(file);
            event.target.value = '';
        }

        // Export Bills CSV
        async function exportBillsCSV() {
            closeBurgerMenu();
            try {
                const blob = await window.api.exportBillsCSV();
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = url;
                a.download = `bills-export-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`;
                document.body.appendChild(a);
                a.click();
                document.body.removeChild(a);
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                alert('✅ Bills exported as CSV successfully!');
            } catch (error) {
                alert('❌ Error exporting bills CSV: ' + error.message);
            }
        }

        // Import Bills CSV
        function importBillsCSV() {
            document.getElementById('importBillsCsvFile').click();
            closeBurgerMenu();
        }

        async function handleBillsCsvImport(event) {
            const file = event.target.files[0];
            if (!file) return;

            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = async function (e) {
                try {
                    const csvData = e.target.result;

                    // Check if user wants to add to existing data
                    const hasExistingBills = bills.length > 0;
                    if (hasExistingBills) {
                        const confirmImport = confirm(
                            `You have ${bills.length} bills in your account.\n\n` +
                            'Import will ADD the bills from the CSV file to your existing bills.\n\n' +
                            'Continue with import?'
                        );
                        if (!confirmImport) return;
                    }

                    const result = await window.api.importBillsCSV(csvData);

                    let message = '✅ CSV Import Complete!\n\n';
                    message += `📝 Imported ${result.imported} bill(s)\n`;
                    if (result.errors > 0) {
                        message += `⚠️ ${result.errors} error(s) encountered\n`;
                        if (result.details && result.details.length > 0) {
                            message += '\nErrors:\n';
                            result.details.forEach(err => {
                                message += `Line ${err.line}: ${err.error}\n`;
                            });
                        }
                    }

                    alert(message);
                    await loadDashboardData();

                } catch (err) {
                    console.error('CSV import error:', err);
                    alert('❌ Error importing CSV: ' + err.message);
                }
            };
            reader.readAsText(file);
            event.target.value = '';
        }

        // Logout
        function handleLogout() {
            if (confirm('Are you sure you want to logout?')) {
                localStorage.removeItem('authToken');
                // Reload page to trigger demo mode
                window.location.reload();
            }
        }

        // Close modals on outside click
        document.getElementById('addSessionModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id === 'addSessionModal') closeAddSessionModal();
        });

        document.getElementById('addBillModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id === 'addBillModal') closeAddBillModal();
        });

        document.getElementById('editSessionModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id === 'editSessionModal') closeEditSessionModal();
        });

        document.getElementById('editBillModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id === 'editBillModal') closeEditBillModal();
        });

        document.getElementById('sprintSettingsModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.id === 'sprintSettingsModal') closeSprintSettingsModal();
        });

        // ===== AUTH MODAL HANDLERS =====

        function showLoginModal() {
            document.getElementById('loginModal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function closeLoginModal() {
            document.getElementById('loginModal').classList.remove('active');
            document.getElementById('loginErrorMessage').style.display = 'none';
        }

        function showRegisterModal() {
            document.getElementById('registerModal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function closeRegisterModal() {
            document.getElementById('registerModal').classList.remove('active');
            document.getElementById('registerErrorMessage').style.display = 'none';
        }

        function switchToRegister() {
            closeLoginModal();
            showRegisterModal();
        }

        function switchToLogin() {
            closeRegisterModal();
            showLoginModal();
        }

        async function handleLoginSubmit(event) {
            event.preventDefault();

            const email = document.getElementById('modalLoginEmail').value;
            const password = document.getElementById('modalLoginPassword').value;

            try {
                const response = await window.api.login(email, password);
                localStorage.setItem('authToken', response.token);

                // Clear demo data
                sessionStorage.removeItem('demoSessions');
                sessionStorage.removeItem('demoBills');
                sessionStorage.removeItem('demoSettings');
                isDemoMode = false;

                // Remove demo banner
                const banner = document.getElementById('demoBanner');
                if (banner) banner.remove();

                // Close modal
                closeLoginModal();

                // Load user data
                currentUser = await window.api.getProfile();
                await loadDashboardData();
                showUserMenu();

                console.log('✅ Logged in successfully');
            } catch (error) {
                const errorDiv = document.getElementById('loginErrorMessage');
                errorDiv.textContent = error.message || 'Login failed. Please check your credentials.';
                errorDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        }

        async function handleRegisterSubmit(event) {
            event.preventDefault();

            const name = document.getElementById('modalRegisterName').value;
            const email = document.getElementById('modalRegisterEmail').value;
            const password = document.getElementById('modalRegisterPassword').value;

            try {
                const response = await window.api.register(name, email, password);
                localStorage.setItem('authToken', response.token);

                // Clear demo data
                sessionStorage.removeItem('demoSessions');
                sessionStorage.removeItem('demoBills');
                sessionStorage.removeItem('demoSettings');
                isDemoMode = false;

                // Remove demo banner
                const banner = document.getElementById('demoBanner');
                if (banner) banner.remove();

                // Close modal
                closeRegisterModal();

                // Load user data
                currentUser = await window.api.getProfile();
                await loadDashboardData();
                showUserMenu();

                console.log('✅ Registered and logged in successfully');
            } catch (error) {
                const errorDiv = document.getElementById('registerErrorMessage');
                errorDiv.textContent = error.message || 'Registration failed. Please try again.';
                errorDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        }

        // ESC key to close (including auth modals)
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                closeBurgerMenu();
                closeAddSessionModal();
                closeAddBillModal();
                closeEditSessionModal();
                closeEditBillModal();
                closeSprintSettingsModal();
                closeLoginModal();
                closeRegisterModal();
            }
        });
    </script>
</body>

</html>

# 🏗️ Site Architecture Refactor Plan

## Current State Analysis

### Problems with Current Architecture

1. **Monolithic `index.html`** (3,456 lines!)
   - All JavaScript logic in one `<script>` tag
   - All CSS in one `<style>` tag
   - Hard to maintain and debug
   - Poor code reusability
   - Difficult to test individual components

2. **Confusing Page Structure**
   - `index.html` tries to be both demo page AND dashboard
   - `login.html` exists but is bypassed by modals
   - No clear separation of concerns

3. **No Code Modularity**
   - Demo mode logic mixed with dashboard logic
   - CRUD operations duplicated (demo vs API)
   - No shared utilities or helpers

4. **Poor Scalability**
   - Adding new features requires editing massive files
   - Risk of breaking existing functionality
   - Hard to onboard new developers

---

## Proposed New Architecture

### Option A: Multi-Page Application (Recommended for Your Use Case)

**Structure:**
```
frontend/
├── index.html              # Landing/Demo page
├── dashboard.html          # Authenticated user dashboard
├── login.html              # Login/Register (can keep or remove)
├── css/
│   ├── base.css           # Reset, variables, global styles
│   ├── components.css     # Buttons, modals, cards
│   ├── layout.css         # Header, navigation, grid
│   ├── demo.css           # Demo mode specific styles
│   └── dashboard.css      # Dashboard specific styles
├── js/
│   ├── api.js             # ✅ Already exists
│   ├── config.js          # Configuration (API URLs, constants)
│   ├── utils.js           # Helper functions (date formatting, etc.)
│   ├── auth.js            # Authentication logic
│   ├── demo.js            # Demo mode data generators
│   ├── sessions.js        # Session CRUD operations
│   ├── bills.js           # Bill CRUD operations
│   ├── stats.js           # Statistics calculations
│   ├── modals.js          # Modal management
│   └── main.js            # Page-specific initialization
└── components/
    ├── header.html        # Reusable header component (optional)
    └── modals.html        # Reusable modal templates (optional)
```

**Page Responsibilities:**

- **`index.html` (Landing/Demo Page)**
  - Always accessible without auth
  - Shows demo mode with fake data
  - Login/Register buttons prominent
  - Can interact with demo data
  - NO burger menu (just auth buttons)
  
- **`dashboard.html` (Authenticated Dashboard)**
  - Requires auth token
  - Shows user's real data
  - Burger menu with settings/export/logout
  - Full CRUD operations
  - All features enabled

- **`login.html` (Optional)**
  - Can keep as fallback
  - Or remove entirely if using modals

### Option B: Single Page Application (SPA) with Router

**Structure:**
```
frontend/
├── index.html             # Shell with router
├── css/
│   └── [same as Option A]
├── js/
│   ├── router.js          # Client-side routing
│   ├── pages/
│   │   ├── demo.js        # Demo page controller
│   │   ├── dashboard.js   # Dashboard page controller
│   │   └── login.js       # Login page controller
│   ├── components/
│   │   ├── header.js      # Header component
│   │   ├── sessionList.js # Session list component
│   │   └── billList.js    # Bill list component
│   └── [shared modules]
└── templates/
    ├── demo.html          # Demo page template
    ├── dashboard.html     # Dashboard page template
    └── login.html         # Login page template
```

**Pros:**
- No page reloads (smoother UX)
- Can share state between views
- Modern architecture

**Cons:**
- More complex to implement
- Requires a router library or custom router
- SEO challenges (though not critical for your use case)
- Overkill for current feature set

---

## Recommendation: Option A (Multi-Page)

**Why:**
- ✅ Simpler to implement and maintain
- ✅ Clear separation of concerns
- ✅ Better for your use case (demo vs authenticated)
- ✅ Can incrementally refactor
- ✅ No additional libraries needed
- ✅ Better for SEO (if you care later)

---

## Detailed Refactor Plan (Option A)

### Phase 1: Extract and Organize CSS (1-2 hours)

**Create:**
```
frontend/css/
├── base.css           # Variables, reset, fonts
├── components.css     # Buttons, modals, cards, inputs
├── layout.css         # Header, grid, responsive

#### `js/sessions.js`
```javascript
import api from './api.js';

export async function getSessions(demoMode, demoSessions) {
    if (demoMode) {
        return demoSessions;
    }
    return await api.getSessions();
}

export async function createSession(demoMode, sessionData, demoSessions) {
    if (demoMode) {
        sessionData.id = `demo-${Date.now()}`;
        demoSessions.unshift(sessionData);
        return sessionData;
    }
    return await api.createSession(sessionData);
}

export async function updateSession(demoMode, id, updates, demoSessions) {
    if (demoMode) {
        const index = demoSessions.findIndex(s => s.id === id);
        if (index !== -1) {
            demoSessions[index] = { ...demoSessions[index], ...updates };
            return demoSessions[index];
        }
        throw new Error('Session not found');
    }
    return await api.updateSession(id, updates);
}

export async function deleteSession(demoMode, id, demoSessions) {
    if (demoMode) {
        const index = demoSessions.findIndex(s => s.id === id);
        if (index !== -1) {
            demoSessions.splice(index, 1);
        }
        return;
    }
    return await api.deleteSession(id);
}
```

export function calculateDailyGoal(totalNeeded, daysLeft) {
    return totalNeeded / Math.max(1, daysLeft);
}

export function calculateProgress(earned, needed) {
    if (needed === 0) return earned > 0 ? 100 : 0;
    return Math.min((earned / needed) * 100, 100);
}

export function calculateTotalWithTax(billsTotal, taxRate) {
    return billsTotal * (1 / (1 - (taxRate / 100)));
}

export function calculateTaxReserve(earnings, taxRate) {
    return earnings * (taxRate / 100);
}

        // Check auth
        if (!isAuthenticated()) {
            window.location.href = '/index.html';
        }

        // Load user data
        async function init() {
            const [sessions, bills, settings] = await Promise.all([
                api.getSessions(),
                api.getBills(),
                api.getSettings()
            ]);

            renderDashboard({
                sessions,
                bills,
                settings,
                demoMode: false
            });
        }

        init();
    </script>

**Problem:** `handleLogout()` was redirecting to `/login.html` instead of demo mode

**Solution:**
```javascript

* {

    margin: 0 auto;
}

/* ===== SCROLLBAR STYLING ===== */

::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: #1a1a1a;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: #444;
    border-radius: 4px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: #555;
}

/* ===== UTILITY CLASSES ===== */

.loading {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 40px;
    color: #666;
}

.spinner {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    border: 4px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    border-top-color: #00ff88;
    border-radius: 50%;
    animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes spin {
    to {
        transform: rotate(360deg);
    }
}

.error-message {
    background: #ff3333;
    color: #fff;
    padding: 12px 20px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    display: none;
}

.error-message.show {
    display: block;
}

/* ===== BADGES ===== */

.badge {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 0.75em;
    font-weight: bold;
    margin-left: 8px;
}

.badge.manual {
    background: #444;
    color: #999;
}

.badge.leisure {
    background: #ff3333;
    color: #fff;
}

```css
/* ===== HEADER & NAVIGATION ===== */

.header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    padding-bottom: 15px;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #ff3333;
}

.header-title {
    flex: 1;
}

.header h1 {
    font-size: 2.5em;
    color: #ff3333;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
}

.header-subtitle {
    color: #999;
    font-size: 1em;
}

.burger-btn {
    background: #1a1a1a;
    border: 2px solid #333;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1.5em;
    padding: 10px 15px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s;
}

.burger-btn:hover {
    border-color: #ff3333;
    background: #2a2a2a;
}

/* ===== BURGER MENU ===== */

.burger-menu {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    right: -300px;
    width: 280px;
    height: 100vh;
    background: #1a1a1a;
    border-left: 2px solid #ff3333;
    z-index: 1001;
    padding: 20px;
    transition: right 0.3s ease;
}

.burger-menu.open {
    right: 0;
}

.burger-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
    z-index: 1000;
    display: none;
}

.burger-overlay.show {
    display: block;
}

.burger-menu-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 30px;
    padding-bottom: 15px;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #333;
}

.burger-menu-title {
    font-size: 1.2em;
    font-weight: bold;
}

.burger-close {
    background: none;
    border: none;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1.5em;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 5px;
}

.burger-menu-item {
    padding: 15px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    background: #2a2a2a;
    border: 2px solid #333;
    border-radius: 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    font-size: 1em;
}

.burger-menu-item:hover {
    border-color: #00ff88;
    background: #3a3a3a;
}

.burger-menu-item.logout {
    border-color: #ff3333;
    color: #ff3333;
}

.burger-menu-item.logout:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 51, 51, 0.1);
}

/* ===== COUNTDOWN BANNER ===== */

.deadline-countdown {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a1a 0%, #2a0a0a 100%);
    border: 3px solid #ff3333;
    border-radius: 15px;
    padding: 20px;
    margin: 20px 0;
    text-align: center;
}

.countdown-timer {
    font-size: 4em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #ff3333;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.countdown-label {
    font-size: 1.2em;
    color: #999;
}

/* ===== GRID LAYOUTS ===== */

.hero-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.stats-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr;
    gap: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.main-content {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr;
    gap: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.stats-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 15px;
    margin: 15px 0;
}

.stats-grid.four-col {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
}

/* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */

@media (max-width: 1200px) {
    .hero-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .main-content {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .stats-row {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .header h1 {
        font-size: 1.8em;
    }

    .countdown-timer {
        font-size: 2.5em;
    }

    .stats-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .stats-grid.four-col {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    body {
        padding: 10px;
    }

    .header h1 {
        font-size: 1.5em;
    }

    .countdown-timer {
        font-size: 2em;
    }
}

        /* Hero Dashboard Grid */
        .hero-grid {

        .stats-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr;
            gap: 20px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;

        /* Main Content - Side by Side */
        .main-content {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr;
            gap: 20px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .card {
            background: #1a1a1a;
            border: 2px solid #333;
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        .card.critical {
            border-color: #ff3333;
        }

        .card.warning {
            border-color: #ffaa00;
        }

        .card.success {
            border-color: #00ff88;
        }

        .card-title {
            font-size: 1.3em;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            color: #fff;
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .big-number {
            font-size: 3em;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin: 10px 0;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        /* Progress Bars */
        .progress-bar {
            width: 100%;
            height: 30px;
            background: #2a2a2a;
            border-radius: 15px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin: 12px 0;
            position: relative;
        }

        .progress-fill {
            height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #00ff88 0%, #00cc66 100%);
            transition: width 0.5s ease;
            border-radius: 15px;
        }

        .progress-fill.behind {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff3333 0%, #cc0000 100%);
        }

        .progress-text {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #fff;
            text-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
            font-size: 0.9em;
        }

        /* Timer Controls */
        .timer-display {
            font-size: 3em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #fff;
            text-align: center;
            margin: 20px 0;
            font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .timer-controls {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            margin: 15px 0;
        }

        .btn {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 12px 20px;
            font-size: 1em;
            font-weight: bold;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-start {
            background: #00ff88;
            color: #000;
        }

        .btn-start:hover {
            background: #00cc66;
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .btn-stop {
            background: #ff3333;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .btn-stop:hover {
            background: #cc0000;
        }

        .btn-reset {
            background: #ffaa00;
            color: #000;
        }

        .btn-reset:hover {
            background: #cc8800;
        }

        /* Input Groups */
        .input-group {
            margin: 12px 0;
        }

        .input-group label {
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            color: #999;
            font-size: 0.9em;
        }

        .input-group input {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 10px;
            font-size: 1em;
            background: #2a2a2a;
            border: 2px solid #444;
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .input-group input:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: #00ff88;
        }

        /* Stats Grid */
        .stats-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 12px;
            margin-top: 15px;
        }

        .stats-grid.four-col {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
        }

        .stat-item {
            background: #2a2a2a;
            padding: 15px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .stat-value {
            font-size: 1.8em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #00ff88;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .stat-value.red {
            color: #ff3333;
        }

        .stat-value.yellow {
            color: #ffaa00;
        }

        .stat-label {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #999;
            margin-top: 5px;
        }

        /* Status Messages */
        .status-message {
            padding: 12px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            margin: 12px 0;
            font-weight: bold;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .status-behind {
            background: rgba(255, 51, 51, 0.2);
            border: 2px solid #ff3333;
            color: #ff3333;
        }

        .status-ahead {
            background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.2);
            border: 2px solid #00ff88;
            color: #00ff88;
        }

        /* Session History */
        .session-controls {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .session-controls input[type="date"] {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 150px;
            padding: 8px;
            background: #2a2a2a;
            border: 2px solid #444;
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .btn-small {
            padding: 8px 15px;
            font-size: 0.9em;
            font-weight: bold;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-small.primary {
            background: #00ff88;
            color: #000;
        }

        .btn-small.secondary {
            background: #444;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .btn-small:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .session-history {
            max-height: 500px;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }

        .session-item {
            background: #2a2a2a;
            padding: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            transition: background 0.2s;
        }

        .session-item:hover {
            background: #3a3a3a;
        }

        .session-item.leisure {
            background: rgba(255, 51, 51, 0.05);
            border-left: 3px solid #ff3333;
        }

        .session-info {
            flex: 1;
        }

        .session-time {
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 3px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .session-details {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #999;
        }

        .session-note {
            font-size: 0.85em;
            color: #666;
            margin-top: 5px;
            font-style: italic;
        }

        .session-earnings {
            font-size: 1.3em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #00ff88;
            margin: 0 15px;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .session-earnings.negative {
            color: #ff3333;
        }

        .session-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .action-btn {
            padding: 6px 10px;
            background: #2a2a2a;
            border: 1px solid #444;
            color: #fff;
            border-radius: 5px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 0.9em;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .action-btn:hover {
            background: #3a3a3a;
            border-color: #00ff88;
        }

        .action-btn.delete {
            border-color: #ff3333;
            color: #ff3333;
        }

        .action-btn.delete:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 51, 51, 0.1);
        }

        /* Bills Conveyor */
        .bills-track {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 10px;
            max-height: 400px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        .bill-item {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2a0a0a 0%, #1a1a1a 100%);
            border-left: 5px solid #ff3333;
            padding: 15px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            animation: slideIn 0.5s ease-out;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .bill-item::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 0;
            height: 100%;
            width: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 51, 51, 0.1), transparent);
            animation: shimmer 3s infinite;
        }

        .bill-item.urgent {
            border-left-color: #ff0000;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3a0000 0%, #2a0000 100%);
            animation: pulse 2s infinite, slideIn 0.5s ease-out;
        }

        .bill-item.warning {
            border-left-color: #ffaa00;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2a1a00 0%, #1a1a1a 100%);
        }

        .bill-item.paid {
            border-left-color: #00ff88;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a2a1a 0%, #1a1a1a 100%);
            opacity: 0.6;
        }

        @keyframes slideIn {
            from {
                transform: translateX(-20px);
                opacity: 0;
            }

            to {
                transform: translateX(0);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        @keyframes pulse {

            0%,
            100% {
                box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.7);
            }

            50% {
                box-shadow: 0 0 20px 5px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0);
            }
        }

        @keyframes shimmer {
            0% {
                width: 0;
                left: 0;
            }

            50% {
                width: 100%;
                left: 0;
            }

            100% {
                width: 0;
                left: 100%;
            }
        }

        .bill-info {
            flex: 1;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .bill-name {
            font-size: 1.1em;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
        }

        .bill-due {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #999;
        }

        .bill-due.urgent {
            color: #ff3333;
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .bill-amount {
            font-size: 1.5em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #ff3333;
            text-align: right;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            margin: 0 15px;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .bill-amount.paid {
            color: #00ff88;
            text-decoration: line-through;
        }

        .bill-amount-usd {
            font-size: 0.6em;
            color: #999;
            display: block;
        }

        .bills-total {
            margin-top: 15px;
            padding: 15px;
            background: #2a0a0a;
            border-radius: 8px;
            text-align: center;
            border: 2px solid #ff3333;
        }

        .bills-total-label {
            font-size: 1em;
            color: #999;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .bills-total-amount {
            font-size: 2.5em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #ff3333;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        /* Modal */
        .modal {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
            z-index: 2000;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        .modal.show {
            display: flex;
        }

        .modal-content {
            background: #1a1a1a;
            border: 2px solid #333;
            border-radius: 15px;
            padding: 30px;
            max-width: 500px;
            width: 100%;
            max-height: 90vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
            animation: modalSlideIn 0.3s ease-out;
        }

        @keyframes modalSlideIn {
            from {
                transform: translateY(-50px);
                opacity: 0;
            }

            to {
                transform: translateY(0);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        .modal-header {
            font-size: 1.5em;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            color: #00ff88;
        }

        .form-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        .form-row.full {
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }

        .modal-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .btn-modal-primary {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 12px;
            background: #00ff88;
            color: #000;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-modal-primary:hover {
            background: #00cc66;
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .btn-modal-secondary {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 12px;
            background: #444;
            color: #fff;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-modal-secondary:hover {
            background: #555;
        }

        /* Empty States */
        .empty-state {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 40px 20px;
            color: #666;
        }

        .empty-state-icon {
            font-size: 3em;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        /* Date Group Headers */
        .date-group-header {
            background: #2a2a2a;
            padding: 10px 15px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            margin: 20px 0 10px 0;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #00ff88;
        }

        .date-group-stats {
            color: #999;
        }

        /* Loading State */
        .loading {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 40px;
            color: #666;
        }

        .spinner {
            border: 4px solid #2a2a2a;
            border-top: 4px solid #00ff88;
            border-radius: 50%;
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
            margin: 20px auto;
        }

        @keyframes spin {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0deg);
            }

            100% {
                transform: rotate(360deg);
            }
        }

        /* Responsive */
        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .hero-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .stats-row {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .main-content {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .stats-grid.four-col {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .countdown-timer {
                font-size: 2.5em;
            }

            .big-number {
                font-size: 2em;
            }

            .header h1 {
                font-size: 1.8em;
            }

            .form-row {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
        }

        /* Scrollbar Styling */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: #1a1a1a;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #444;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: #555;
        }

        /* Badge */
        .badge {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 2px 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: 0.75em;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-left: 8px;
        }

        .badge.manual {
            background: #444;
            color: #999;
        }

        .badge.leisure {
            background: #ff3333;
            color: #fff;
        }

        /* ===== DEMO MODE STYLES ===== */

        .demo-banner {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            z-index: 10000;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1 0%, #8b5cf6 100%);
            color: white;
            padding: 12px 20px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3);
            animation: slideDown 0.3s ease-out;
        }

        @keyframes slideDown {
            from {
                transform: translateY(-100%);
                opacity: 0;
            }

            to {
                transform: translateY(0);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        .demo-banner-content {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 15px;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .demo-banner-icon {
            font-size: 1.5em;
        }

        .demo-banner-text {
            font-weight: 500;
            font-size: 0.95em;
        }

        .demo-banner-btn {
            background: white;
            color: #6366f1;
            border: none;
            padding: 8px 20px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            font-size: 0.9em;
        }

        .demo-banner-btn:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
        }

        .demo-banner-dismiss {
            background: transparent;
            color: white;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
            padding: 4px 12px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            font-size: 0.9em;
            margin-left: auto;
        }

        .demo-banner-dismiss:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        }

        /* Auth Buttons (Top Right) */
        .auth-buttons {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .btn-auth {
            padding: 8px 20px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            font-size: 0.9em;
            border: none;
        }

        .btn-login {
            background: transparent;
            color: #fff;
            border: 2px solid #fff;
        }

        .btn-login:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .btn-register {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00ff88 0%, #00cc66 100%);
            color: #000;
        }

        .btn-register:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.4);
        }

        /* Auth Modals */
        .auth-modal {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            z-index: 10001;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            animation: fadeIn 0.2s ease-out;
        }

        .auth-modal.active {
            display: flex;
        }

        .auth-modal-content {
            background: #1a1a1a;
            border: 2px solid #ff3333;
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 40px;
            width: 90%;
            max-width: 450px;
            position: relative;
            animation: slideUp 0.3s ease-out;
        }

        @keyframes slideUp {
            from {
                transform: translateY(30px);
                opacity: 0;
            }

            to {
                transform: translateY(0);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        .auth-modal-close {
            position: absolute;
            top: 15px;
            right: 20px;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: #999;
            font-size: 1.5em;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 5px;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .auth-modal-close:hover {
            color: #fff;
        }

        /* Responsive Demo Banner */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .demo-banner-content {
                flex-direction: column;
                gap: 10px;
            }

            .demo-banner-text {
                font-size: 0.85em;
                text-align: center;
            }

            .demo-banner-dismiss {
                margin-left: 0;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

<body>
    <div class="container">
        <!-- Header with Burger Menu -->
        <div class="header">
            <div class="header-title">
                <h1>🔥 SURVIVAL MODE 🔥</h1>
                <div class="header-subtitle">Last Day to Work: October 24, 2025</div>
            </div>
            <button class="burger-btn" onclick="toggleBurgerMenu()">☰</button>
        </div>

        <!-- Burger Menu Overlay -->
        <div class="burger-overlay" id="burgerOverlay" onclick="closeBurgerMenu()"></div>

        <!-- Burger Menu -->
        <div class="burger-menu" id="burgerMenu">
            <div class="burger-menu-header">
                <div class="burger-menu-title">Menu</div>
                <button class="burger-close" onclick="closeBurgerMenu()">✕</button>
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="exportData()">
                📥 Export Data (JSON)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="importData()">
                📤 Import Data (JSON)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="exportBillsCSV()">
                📋 Export Bills (CSV)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="importBillsCSV()">
                📂 Import Bills (CSV)
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item" onclick="showSprintSettingsModal()">
                ⚙️ Sprint Settings
            </div>
            <div class="burger-menu-item logout" onclick="handleLogout()">
                🚪 Logout
            </div>
        </div>
        <input type="file" id="importFile" accept=".json" style="display: none;" onchange="handleImport(event)">
        <input type="file" id="importBillsCsvFile" accept=".csv" style="display: none;"
            onchange="handleBillsCsvImport(event)">

        <!-- Countdown Banner -->
        <div class="deadline-countdown">
            <div class="countdown-timer" id="countdown">--:--:--</div>
            <div class="countdown-label">Until Oct 24 Work Deadline</div>
        </div>

        <!-- Hero Dashboard Grid -->
        <div class="hero-grid">
            <!-- Today's Goal -->
            <div class="card critical">
                <div class="card-title">💰 TODAY'S GOAL</div>
                <div class="big-number" id="dailyGoal">$0</div>
                <div class="progress-bar">
                    <div class="progress-fill" id="todayProgress" style="width: 0%"></div>
                    <div class="progress-text" id="todayProgressText">$0 / $0</div>
                </div>
                <div id="todayStatus" class="status-message status-behind">
                    Loading...
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Work Timer -->
            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">⏱️ WORK TIMER</div>
                <div class="timer-display" id="timerDisplay">00:00:00</div>
                <div class="timer-controls">
                    <button class="btn btn-start" id="startBtn" onclick="startTimer()">START</button>
                    <button class="btn btn-stop" id="stopBtn" onclick="stopTimer()" style="display:none">STOP</button>
                    <button class="btn btn-reset" id="resetBtn" onclick="resetTimer()">RESET</button>
                </div>
                <div class="input-group">
                    <label>Hourly Rate ($)</label>
                    <input type="number" id="hourlyRate" value="24" min="0" max="100" step="0.5">
                    <div style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #666; margin-top: 5px;">
                        Set to $0 for leisure/break time
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-item" style="margin-top: 15px;">
                    <div class="stat-value" id="currentSessionEarnings">$0.00</div>
                    <div class="stat-label">Current Session</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- 9-Day Sprint -->
            <div class="card warning">
                <div class="card-title">📊 9-DAY SPRINT</div>
                <div class="big-number" id="totalEarned">$0</div>
                <div style="font-size: 0.9em; color: #999;">of $<span id="totalNeeded">0</span> needed</div>
                <div class="progress-bar">
                    <div class="progress-fill" id="sprintProgress" style="width: 0%"></div>
                    <div class="progress-text" id="sprintProgressText">0%</div>
                </div>
                <div class="stats-grid">
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value" id="daysLeft">0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Days Left</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value red" id="remaining">$0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">To Earn</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Stats Row -->
        <div class="stats-row">
            <!-- Quick Stats -->
            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">📈 QUICK STATS</div>
                <div class="stats-grid">
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value" id="todayHours">0.0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Hours Today</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value" id="todayEarnings">$0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Earned Today</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value" id="hoursNeeded">0.0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Hrs/Day Needed</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value" id="totalHoursNeeded">0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Total Hrs Left</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Bills Breakdown -->
            <div class="card critical">
                <div class="card-title">💸 BILLS BREAKDOWN (CAD → USD)</div>
                <div class="stats-grid four-col">
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value red" id="billsTotalCAD">$0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Total CAD</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value yellow" id="billsTotalUSD">$0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Total USD (~1.4)</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value red" id="billsWithTax">$0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">USD + Tax (33%)</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <div class="stat-value" id="billsCovered">0%</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Covered</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Main Content: Sessions + Bills Side by Side -->
        <div class="main-content">
            <!-- Session History -->
            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">📝 SESSION HISTORY</div>
                <div class="session-controls">
                    <input type="date" id="viewDate">
                    <button class="btn-small primary" onclick="viewToday()">Today</button>
                    <button class="btn-small secondary" onclick="viewAllDays()">All</button>
                    <button class="btn-small primary" onclick="showAddSessionModal()">➕ Add Manual Entry</button>
                </div>
                <div class="session-history" id="sessionHistory">
                    <div class="loading">
                        <div class="spinner"></div>
                        Loading sessions...
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Bills Conveyor -->
            <div class="card critical">
                <div class="card-title">💸 BILLS CONVEYOR</div>
                <button class="btn-small primary" style="width: 100%; margin-bottom: 15px;"
                    onclick="showAddBillModal()">➕ Add Bill</button>
                <div class="bills-track" id="billsTrack">
                    <div class="loading">
                        <div class="spinner"></div>
                        Loading bills...
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="bills-total">
                    <div class="bills-total-label">TOTAL REMAINING</div>
                    <div class="bills-total-amount" id="billsTotal">$0.00</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Tax Savings Tracker (Bottom of Page) -->
        <div class="card warning" style="max-width: 1400px; margin: 20px auto;">
            <div class="card-title">💰 TAX RESERVE TRACKING</div>
            <div class="stats-grid four-col">
                <div class="stat-item">
                    <div class="stat-value" id="taxEarnings">$0</div>
                    <div class="stat-label">Work Earnings</div>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-item">
                    <div class="stat-value yellow" id="taxReserve">$0</div>
                    <div class="stat-label">Should Save</div>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-item">
                    <div class="stat-value green" id="taxAfter">$0</div>
                    <div class="stat-label">After Taxes</div>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-item">
                    <div class="stat-value" id="taxRate">30%</div>
                    <div class="stat-label">Reserve Rate</div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div style="margin-top: 15px; padding-top: 15px; border-top: 1px solid #333;">
                <label style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; cursor: pointer; color: #999;">
                    <input type="checkbox" id="taxIncludeInitial" onchange="updateStats()" style="width: auto;">
                    <span>Include Initial Balance ($<span id="taxInitialAmount">0</span>) in tax calculation</span>
                </label>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Add Session Modal -->
    <div class="modal" id="addSessionModal">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">➕ Add Work Session</div>
            <form onsubmit="addManualSession(event)">
                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Date</label>
                        <input type="date" id="manualDate" required>
                    </div>
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Rate ($/hr)</label>
                        <input type="number" id="manualRate" min="0" max="100" step="0.5" value="24" required>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Start Time</label>
                        <input type="time" id="manualStartTime" required>
                    </div>
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>End Time</label>
                        <input type="time" id="manualEndTime" required>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Note (optional)</label>
                        <input type="text" id="manualNote" placeholder="What did you work on?">
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-actions">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn-modal-primary">Add Session</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-modal-secondary" onclick="closeAddSessionModal()">Cancel</button>
                </div>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Add Bill Modal -->
    <div class="modal" id="addBillModal">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">💸 Add Bill</div>
            <form onsubmit="addBill(event)">
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Bill Name</label>
                        <input type="text" id="billName" placeholder="e.g., Rent, Utilities" required>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Amount CAD</label>
                        <input type="number" id="billAmountCAD" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="0.00" required
                            onchange="autoCalculateUSD()">
                    </div>
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Amount USD</label>
                        <input type="number" id="billAmountUSD" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="0.00" required>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Due Date (optional)</label>
                        <input type="date" id="billDueDate">
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-actions">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn-modal-primary">Add Bill</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-modal-secondary" onclick="closeAddBillModal()">Cancel</button>
                </div>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Edit Bill Modal -->
    <div class="modal" id="editBillModal">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">✏️ Edit Bill</div>
            <form onsubmit="updateBill(event)">
                <input type="hidden" id="editBillId">
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Bill Name</label>
                        <input type="text" id="editBillName" placeholder="e.g., Rent, Utilities" required>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Amount CAD</label>
                        <input type="number" id="editBillAmountCAD" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="0.00" required
                            onchange="autoCalculateEditBillUSD()">
                    </div>
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Amount USD</label>
                        <input type="number" id="editBillAmountUSD" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="0.00" required>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Due Date (optional)</label>
                        <input type="date" id="editBillDueDate">
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; cursor: pointer;">
                            <input type="checkbox" id="editBillPaid" style="width: auto;">
                            <span>Mark as Paid</span>
                        </label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-actions">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn-modal-primary">Save Changes</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-modal-secondary" onclick="closeEditBillModal()">Cancel</button>
                </div>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Edit Session Modal -->
    <div class="modal" id="editSessionModal">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">✏️ Edit Work Session</div>
            <form onsubmit="updateSession(event)">
                <input type="hidden" id="editSessionId">
                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Date</label>
                        <input type="date" id="editSessionDate" required>
                    </div>
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Start Time</label>
                        <input type="time" id="editSessionTime" required>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Hours Worked</label>
                        <input type="number" id="editSessionHours" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="0.00" required
                            onchange="calculateEditEarnings()">
                    </div>
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Hourly Rate ($)</label>
                        <input type="number" id="editSessionRate" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="0.00" required
                            onchange="calculateEditEarnings()">
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Notes</label>
                        <input type="text" id="editSessionNote" placeholder="What did you work on?">
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; cursor: pointer;">
                            <input type="checkbox" id="editSessionLeisure" style="width: auto;"
                                onchange="calculateEditEarnings()">
                            <span>This is leisure/break time (no earnings)</span>
                        </label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-item"
                    style="margin-top: 15px; padding: 15px; background: #2a2a2a; border-radius: 8px;">
                    <div class="stat-label">Calculated Earnings</div>
                    <div class="stat-value" id="editSessionEarnings">$0.00</div>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-actions">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn-modal-primary">Save Changes</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-modal-secondary" onclick="closeEditSessionModal()">Cancel</button>
                </div>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Sprint Settings Modal -->
    <div class="modal" id="sprintSettingsModal">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">⚙️ Sprint Settings</div>
            <form onsubmit="saveSprintSettings(event)">
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Sprint End Date & Time</label>
                        <input type="datetime-local" id="sprintEndDate" required>
                        <div style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #666; margin-top: 5px;">
                            The deadline for your sprint
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Target Bills Mode</label>
                        <select id="targetBillsMode" onchange="toggleManualTarget()"
                            style="padding: 10px; background: #2a2a2a; color: #fff; border: 2px solid #333; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1em;">
                            <option value="auto_unpaid">Auto - Unpaid Bills Only</option>
                            <option value="auto_all">Auto - All Bills</option>
                            <option value="manual">Manual Target</option>
                        </select>
                        <div style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #666; margin-top: 5px;">
                            How to calculate your sprint target
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row full" id="manualTargetRow" style="display: none;">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Manual Target Amount ($)</label>
                        <input type="number" id="targetBillsManual" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="0.00">
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>💰 Initial Balance (Starting Earnings)</label>
                        <input type="number" id="initialBalance" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="0.00" required>
                        <div style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #666; margin-top: 5px;">
                            Money earned before tracking started
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Currency</label>
                        <select id="initialBalanceCurrency"
                            style="padding: 10px; background: #2a2a2a; color: #fff; border: 2px solid #333; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1em;">
                            <option value="USD">USD ($)</option>
                            <option value="CAD">CAD ($)</option>
                        </select>
                        <div style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #666; margin-top: 5px;">
                            Will auto-convert to USD
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Default Hourly Rate ($)</label>
                        <input type="number" id="defaultHourlyRate" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="55.00" required>
                    </div>
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>Tax Reserve Rate (%)</label>
                        <input type="number" id="taxReserveRate" step="0.01" min="0" max="100" placeholder="30.00"
                            required>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row full">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <label>CAD to USD Exchange Rate</label>
                        <input type="number" id="exchangeRate" step="0.0001" min="0" placeholder="0.7143" required>
                        <div style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #666; margin-top: 5px;">
                            1 CAD = ? USD (e.g., 0.7143 means $1 CAD = $0.71 USD)
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-actions">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn-modal-primary">Save Settings</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-modal-secondary"
                        onclick="closeSprintSettingsModal()">Cancel</button>
                </div>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Login Modal -->
    <div class="auth-modal" id="loginModal">
        <div class="auth-modal-content">
            <button class="auth-modal-close" onclick="closeLoginModal()">×</button>
            <h2 style="color: #ff3333; margin-bottom: 10px; text-align: center;">Login</h2>
            <p style="text-align: center; color: #666; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 14px;">Access your dashboard</p>

            <div class="error-message" id="loginErrorMessage" style="display: none;"></div>

            <form onsubmit="handleLoginSubmit(event)">
                <div style="margin-bottom: 20px;">
                    <label style="display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; color: #999; font-size: 14px;">Email</label>
                    <input type="email" id="modalLoginEmail" required placeholder="your@email.com"
                        style="width: 100%; padding: 12px; background: #2a2a2a; color: #fff; border: 2px solid #333; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1em;">
                </div>
                <div style="margin-bottom: 20px;">
                    <label style="display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; color: #999; font-size: 14px;">Password</label>
                    <input type="password" id="modalLoginPassword" required placeholder="••••••••"
                        style="width: 100%; padding: 12px; background: #2a2a2a; color: #fff; border: 2px solid #333; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1em;">
                </div>
                <button type="submit"
                    style="width: 100%; padding: 14px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00ff88 0%, #00cc66 100%); color: #000; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; font-size: 1em;">
                    Login
                </button>
            </form>
            <p style="text-align: center; margin-top: 20px; color: #999; font-size: 14px;">
                Don't have an account?
                <button onclick="switchToRegister()"
                    style="background: none; border: none; color: #00ff88; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: underline;">Register</button>
            </p>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Register Modal -->
    <div class="auth-modal" id="registerModal">
        <div class="auth-modal-content">
            <button class="auth-modal-close" onclick="closeRegisterModal()">×</button>
            <h2 style="color: #ff3333; margin-bottom: 10px; text-align: center;">Create Account</h2>
            <p style="text-align: center; color: #666; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 14px;">Start tracking your
                progress</p>

            <div class="error-message" id="registerErrorMessage" style="display: none;"></div>

            <form onsubmit="handleRegisterSubmit(event)">
                <div style="margin-bottom: 20px;">
                    <label style="display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; color: #999; font-size: 14px;">Full Name</label>
                    <input type="text" id="modalRegisterName" required placeholder="John Doe"
                        style="width: 100%; padding: 12px; background: #2a2a2a; color: #fff; border: 2px solid #333; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1em;">
                </div>
                <div style="margin-bottom: 20px;">
                    <label style="display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; color: #999; font-size: 14px;">Email</label>
                    <input type="email" id="modalRegisterEmail" required placeholder="your@email.com"
                        style="width: 100%; padding: 12px; background: #2a2a2a; color: #fff; border: 2px solid #333; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1em;">
                </div>
                <div style="margin-bottom: 20px;">
                    <label style="display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; color: #999; font-size: 14px;">Password</label>
                    <input type="password" id="modalRegisterPassword" required placeholder="••••••••" minlength="8"
                        style="width: 100%; padding: 12px; background: #2a2a2a; color: #fff; border: 2px solid #333; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1em;">
                    <p style="font-size: 12px; color: #666; margin-top: 5px;">• At least 8 characters long</p>
                </div>
                <button type="submit"
                    style="width: 100%; padding: 14px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00ff88 0%, #00cc66 100%); color: #000; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; font-size: 1em;">
                    Create Account
                </button>
            </form>
            <p style="text-align: center; margin-top: 20px; color: #999; font-size: 14px;">
                Already have an account?
                <button onclick="switchToLogin()"
                    style="background: none; border: none; color: #00ff88; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: underline;">Login</button>
